import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import messagebox
import ttkbootstrap as ttk
from ttkbootstrap.constants import *
import os
import cv2
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageTk

from src.project_management.manager import ProjectManager

class DatasetManagerGUI(ttk.Frame):
    def __init__(self, master, image_paths: list, project_name: str, app=None):
        super().__init__(master)
        self.app = app
        self.image_paths = image_paths
        self.project_name = project_name
        self.project_manager = ProjectManager()
        
        self.current_image_index = 0
        self.image_points = {}
        self.current_cv_image = None
        self.current_photo = None
        
        # --- Config & State ---
        self.zoom_level = 1.0
        self.mode = tk.StringVar(value="points")
        self.num_clusters_var = tk.StringVar(value="10")
        
        # Area Selection State
        self.rect = None
        self.start_x = None
        self.start_y = None

        self.load_config()
        self._build_ui()
        self.load_image()

    def _build_ui(self):
        # 1. Top Bar: Image Navigation
        top_bar = ttk.Frame(self, padding=5, bootstyle="secondary")
        top_bar.pack(fill=X)
        
        ttk.Button(top_bar, text="<< Previous", command=self.prev_image, bootstyle="secondary-outline").pack(side=LEFT)
        
        self.image_label = ttk.Label(top_bar, text="", font=("Helvetica", 11, "bold"), bootstyle="inverse-secondary")
        self.image_label.pack(side=LEFT, expand=True) # Centers it due to pack mechanics if neighbors are fixed
        
        ttk.Button(top_bar, text="Next >>", command=self.next_image, bootstyle="secondary-outline").pack(side=RIGHT)

        # 2. Center: Canvas (The Studio)
        # Using a dark background frame to hold the canvas for that "Studio" feel
        canvas_container = ttk.Frame(self) 
        canvas_container.pack(fill=BOTH, expand=True)
        
        colors = self.app.get_current_colors() if self.app else {}
        bg_col = colors.get("canvas_bg", "#1e1e1e")
        
        self.canvas = tk.Canvas(canvas_container, bg=bg_col, highlightthickness=0)
        self.canvas.pack(fill=BOTH, expand=True)

        # 3. Bottom Control Panel (The Console)
        console = ttk.Frame(self, padding=10, bootstyle="light")
        console.pack(fill=X, side=BOTTOM)
        
        # Zone 1: Zoom
        z_frame = ttk.Labelframe(console, text="Zoom", padding=5)
        z_frame.pack(side=LEFT, padx=(0, 10), fill=Y)
        ttk.Button(z_frame, text="+", width=3, command=lambda: self._zoom(1.2)).pack(side=LEFT, padx=2)
        ttk.Button(z_frame, text="-", width=3, command=lambda: self._zoom(0.8)).pack(side=LEFT, padx=2)

        # Zone 2: Mode (Segmented Button Style)
        m_frame = ttk.Labelframe(console, text="Mode", padding=5)
        m_frame.pack(side=LEFT, padx=(0, 10), fill=Y)
        
        # Bootstyle 'toolbutton' behaves like a toggle/radio
        self.btn_mode_add = ttk.Radiobutton(m_frame, text="Add Points", variable=self.mode, value="points", bootstyle="primary-toolbutton", command=self._update_bindings)
        self.btn_mode_add.pack(side=LEFT, padx=2)
        
        self.btn_mode_del = ttk.Radiobutton(m_frame, text="Delete Point", variable=self.mode, value="delete", bootstyle="danger-toolbutton", command=self._update_bindings)
        self.btn_mode_del.pack(side=LEFT, padx=2)
        
        self.btn_mode_area = ttk.Radiobutton(m_frame, text="Select Area", variable=self.mode, value="area", bootstyle="info-toolbutton", command=self._update_bindings)
        self.btn_mode_area.pack(side=LEFT, padx=2)

        # Zone 3: Parameters (Cluster)
        p_frame = ttk.Labelframe(console, text="Parameters", padding=5)
        p_frame.pack(side=LEFT, padx=(0, 10), fill=Y)
        
        ttk.Label(p_frame, text="Clusters:").pack(side=LEFT)
        ttk.Entry(p_frame, textvariable=self.num_clusters_var, width=5).pack(side=LEFT, padx=5)
        
        ttk.Checkbutton(p_frame, text="Get Colors (Fast)", variable=self.mode, onvalue="getcolors", offvalue="area", bootstyle="round-toggle", command=self._update_bindings).pack(side=LEFT, padx=5)

        # Zone 4: Actions
        a_frame = ttk.Frame(console)
        a_frame.pack(side=RIGHT, fill=Y)
        
        ttk.Button(a_frame, text="Clear Image Points", command=self.clear_points, bootstyle="secondary-link").pack(side=LEFT, padx=10)
        ttk.Button(a_frame, text="Save & Close", command=self.save_and_close, bootstyle="success", width=15).pack(side=LEFT)

        self._update_bindings()

    def _update_bindings(self):
        self.canvas.unbind("<Button-1>")
        self.canvas.unbind("<ButtonPress-1>")
        self.canvas.unbind("<B1-Motion>")
        self.canvas.unbind("<ButtonRelease-1>")

        mode = self.mode.get()
        if mode == "points":
            self.canvas.config(cursor="cross")
            self.canvas.bind("<Button-1>", self._handle_point_click)
        elif mode in ["area", "getcolors"]:
            self.canvas.config(cursor="tcross")
            self.canvas.bind("<ButtonPress-1>", self._on_area_press)
            self.canvas.bind("<B1-Motion>", self._on_area_drag)
            self.canvas.bind("<ButtonRelease-1>", self._on_area_release)
        elif mode == "delete":
            self.canvas.config(cursor="X_cursor") # 'pirate' not always avail
            self.canvas.bind("<Button-1>", self._handle_delete_click)

        # Always enable Pan/Zoom
        self.canvas.bind("<Control-MouseWheel>", self._on_mouse_wheel)
        self.canvas.bind("<ButtonPress-2>", self._on_drag_start) # Middle click pan
        self.canvas.bind("<B2-Motion>", self._on_drag_motion)

    # --- Loading & Drawing Logic (Mostly Preserved) ---
    def load_config(self):
        try:
            config_data = self.project_manager._get_dataset_item_processing_config(self.project_name)
            for img_config in config_data.image_configs:
                if img_config.method == "points" and img_config.points:
                    self.image_points[img_config.filename] = [p.model_dump() for p in img_config.points]
        except Exception: pass

    def load_image(self):
        image_path = self.image_paths[self.current_image_index]
        self.image_label.config(text=f"Image {self.current_image_index + 1} / {len(self.image_paths)}: {os.path.basename(image_path)}")

        self.current_cv_image = cv2.imread(str(image_path))
        if self.current_cv_image is None: return

        # Fit to View (Approx)
        win_w, win_h = 1000, 700 # Approx workspace size
        h, w, _ = self.current_cv_image.shape
        self.zoom_level = min(win_w/w, win_h/h, 1.0) * 0.9

        self.redraw_canvas()

    def redraw_canvas(self):
        if self.current_cv_image is None: return
        self.canvas.delete("all")
        
        h, w, _ = self.current_cv_image.shape
        nw, nh = int(w * self.zoom_level), int(h * self.zoom_level)
        
        img_rgb = cv2.cvtColor(self.current_cv_image, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)
        pil_img = Image.fromarray(img_rgb).resize((nw, nh), Image.Resampling.BILINEAR)
        self.current_photo = ImageTk.PhotoImage(image=pil_img)
        
        # Center the image in the canvas if it's smaller than the canvas
        c_w = self.canvas.winfo_width()
        c_h = self.canvas.winfo_height()
        
        colors = self.app.get_current_colors() if self.app else {}
        bg_col = colors.get("canvas_bg", "#1e1e1e")
        self.canvas.config(bg=bg_col)
        
        x_offset = max(0, (c_w - nw) // 2)
        y_offset = max(0, (c_h - nh) // 2)

        self.canvas.config(scrollregion=(0, 0, max(nw, c_w), max(nh, c_h)))
        self.canvas.create_image(x_offset, y_offset, anchor=tk.NW, image=self.current_photo)
        
        self.draw_points(x_offset, y_offset)
        self.canvas_offset_x = x_offset
        self.canvas_offset_y = y_offset

    def draw_points(self, off_x, off_y):
        self.canvas.delete("point")
        fname = os.path.basename(self.image_paths[self.current_image_index])
        points = self.image_points.get(fname, [])
        
        colors = self.app.get_current_colors() if self.app else {}
        p_col = colors.get("canvas_point", "#00ff00")
        
        for i, p in enumerate(points):
            cx = (p['x'] * self.zoom_level) + off_x
            cy = (p['y'] * self.zoom_level) + off_y
            r = p.get('radius', 7)
            self.canvas.create_oval(cx-r, cy-r, cx+r, cy+r, fill=p_col, outline="black", tags=("point", f"p_{i}"))

    def _zoom(self, factor):
        self.zoom_level *= factor
        self.redraw_canvas()

    def _on_mouse_wheel(self, event):
        factor = 1.1 if (event.delta > 0 or event.num == 4) else 0.9
        self._zoom(factor)
        return "break"
    
    def _on_drag_start(self, event): self.canvas.scan_mark(event.x, event.y)
    def _on_drag_motion(self, event): self.canvas.scan_dragto(event.x, event.y, gain=1)

    # --- Interaction Logic ---
    def _to_img_coords(self, cx, cy):
        # Inverse of draw_points logic
        # cx = (img_x * zoom) + offset  => img_x = (cx - offset) / zoom
        ix = int((self.canvas.canvasx(cx) - getattr(self, 'canvas_offset_x', 0)) / self.zoom_level)
        iy = int((self.canvas.canvasy(cy) - getattr(self, 'canvas_offset_y', 0)) / self.zoom_level)
        return ix, iy

    def _handle_point_click(self, event):
        ix, iy = self._to_img_coords(event.x, event.y)
        fname = os.path.basename(self.image_paths[self.current_image_index])
        if fname not in self.image_points: self.image_points[fname] = []
        self.image_points[fname].append({"x": ix, "y": iy, "radius": 7})
        self.redraw_canvas()

    def _handle_delete_click(self, event):
        ix, iy = self._to_img_coords(event.x, event.y)
        fname = os.path.basename(self.image_paths[self.current_image_index])
        points = self.image_points.get(fname, [])
        if not points: return
        
        # Simple distance check
        for i, p in enumerate(points):
            dist = np.sqrt((p['x'] - ix)**2 + (p['y'] - iy)**2)
            if dist <= (p.get('radius', 7) / self.zoom_level) + 5: # Tolerance
                points.pop(i)
                self.redraw_canvas()
                break

    # --- Area Logic (Brief) ---
    def _on_area_press(self, e):
        self.start_x = self.canvas.canvasx(e.x)
        self.start_y = self.canvas.canvasy(e.y)
        if self.rect: self.canvas.delete(self.rect)
        self.rect = self.canvas.create_rectangle(self.start_x, self.start_y, self.start_x, self.start_y, outline='cyan', dash=(4,2))

    def _on_area_drag(self, e):
        cur_x, cur_y = self.canvas.canvasx(e.x), self.canvas.canvasy(e.y)
        self.canvas.coords(self.rect, self.start_x, self.start_y, cur_x, cur_y)

    def _on_area_release(self, e):
        if not self.rect: return
        x1, y1 = self._to_img_coords(min(self.start_x, self.canvas.canvasx(e.x)), min(self.start_y, self.canvas.canvasy(e.y)))
        x2, y2 = self._to_img_coords(max(self.start_x, self.canvas.canvasx(e.x)), max(self.start_y, self.canvas.canvasy(e.y)))
        
        self.canvas.delete(self.rect)
        self.rect = None
        
        if abs(x2-x1) > 5 and abs(y2-y1) > 5:
            if self.mode.get() == "area": self._perform_clustering(x1, y1, x2, y2)
            elif self.mode.get() == "getcolors": self._perform_getcolors(x1, y1, x2, y2)

    def _perform_clustering(self, x1, y1, x2, y2):
        # (Same logic as before, just ensuring integration)
        try: k = int(self.num_clusters_var.get())
        except: return
        roi = self.current_cv_image[y1:y2, x1:x2]
        if roi.size == 0: return
        pixels = roi.reshape(-1, 3).astype(np.float32)
        _, _, centers = cv2.kmeans(pixels, k, None, (cv2.TERM_CRITERIA_EPS + cv2.TERM_CRITERIA_MAX_ITER, 10, 1.0), 10, cv2.KMEANS_RANDOM_CENTERS)
        
        new_pts = []
        for c in centers:
            # Find closest pixel in ROI to this center color (simple heuristic for location)
            dists = np.linalg.norm(pixels - c, axis=1)
            idx = np.argmin(dists)
            ry, rx = np.unravel_index(idx, (roi.shape[0], roi.shape[1]))
            new_pts.append({"x": int(rx+x1), "y": int(ry+y1), "radius": 7})
            
        fname = os.path.basename(self.image_paths[self.current_image_index])
        if fname not in self.image_points: self.image_points[fname] = []
        self.image_points[fname].extend(new_pts)
        self.redraw_canvas()

    def _perform_getcolors(self, x1, y1, x2, y2):
        roi = self.current_cv_image[y1:y2, x1:x2]
        if roi.size == 0: return
        pil = Image.fromarray(cv2.cvtColor(roi, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB))
        cols = pil.getcolors(maxcolors=10000)
        if not cols: return
        
        # Simplistic mapping: just find first occurrence of each color
        # Optimized: Just scan ROI once
        seen = set()
        new_pts = []
        for r in range(roi.shape[0]):
            for c in range(roi.shape[1]):
                color = tuple(roi[r,c]) # BGR
                if color not in seen:
                    seen.add(color)
                    new_pts.append({"x": c+x1, "y": r+y1, "radius": 7})
        
        fname = os.path.basename(self.image_paths[self.current_image_index])
        if fname not in self.image_points: self.image_points[fname] = []
        self.image_points[fname].extend(new_pts)
        self.redraw_canvas()

    def next_image(self):
        if self.current_image_index < len(self.image_paths) - 1:
            self.current_image_index += 1
            self.load_image()
    
    def prev_image(self):
        if self.current_image_index > 0:
            self.current_image_index -= 1
            self.load_image()

    def clear_points(self):
        fname = os.path.basename(self.image_paths[self.current_image_index])
        self.image_points[fname] = []
        self.redraw_canvas()

    def save_and_close(self):
        try:
            for path in self.image_paths:
                fname = os.path.basename(path)
                pts = self.image_points.get(fname)
                if pts is not None:
                    self.project_manager.update_dataset_item_points(self.project_name, fname, pts)
            
            # Go back to empty state in parent tab
            self.destroy()
            messagebox.showinfo("Saved", "Configuration saved.")
        except Exception as e: messagebox.showerror("Error", str(e))

# Roadmap: Point Management Panel & Blur Tool

## Goal
Improve the precision and manageability of sample point selection in both the Desktop (Tkinter) and Web (React) interfaces.
1.  **Point Management Panel:** A dedicated side panel displaying a list/grid of selected points for the current image. This allows users to see all points, select them, and delete specific ones easily.
2.  **Blur Tool:** A non-destructive blur slider. This visually blurs the image and, crucially, affects the color sampling. When the image is blurred, new points or existing points will reflect the averaged color of the blurred region, helping to reduce noise in color selection.

## Phases

### Phase 1: Planning & Setup
- [x] Analyze existing codebase for Tkinter GUI (`src/gui/dataset_gui.py`).
- [x] Analyze existing codebase for Web GUI (`web-gui/src/features/dataset/PointSelector.tsx`).
- [x] Create Roadmap and Todo list.

### Phase 2: Tkinter Implementation (Desktop)
- [ ] **UI Layout Update:** Refactor `DatasetManagerGUI` to include a side panel (Treeview or Listbox) for points.
- [ ] **Blur Controls:** Add a slider/scale for blur radius in the control panel.
- [ ] **Blur Logic:** Implement dynamic `cv2.GaussianBlur` generation. Ensure the canvas renders the blurred image and point colors are sampled from this blurred version.
- [ ] **Panel Interaction:** Implement bidirectional highlighting (Canvas <-> Panel) and deletion from the panel.

### Phase 3: Web GUI Implementation (React)
- [ ] **UI Layout Update:** Update `PointSelector` to use a grid layout with a sidebar for the point list.
- [ ] **Blur Controls:** Add a range slider for blur amount.
- [ ] **Blur Rendering:** Use HTML Canvas `ctx.filter` or CSS filters (depending on sampling strategy) to render the blur.
- [ ] **Sampling Logic:** Ensure `ctx.getImageData` captures the blurred pixel data.
- [ ] **Panel Interaction:** Render a list of points with color previews and delete actions.

### Phase 4: Verification
- [ ] Verify Tkinter: Points added on blurred image show "smoother" colors. Deleting from panel works.
- [ ] Verify Web: Blur slider works, sampling picks up blurred colors. Panel syncs with canvas.

import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import messagebox
import ttkbootstrap as ttk
from ttkbootstrap.constants import *
import os
import cv2
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageTk

from src.project_management.manager import ProjectManager

class DatasetManagerGUI(ttk.Frame):
    def __init__(self, master, image_paths: list, project_name: str, app=None):
        super().__init__(master)
        self.app = app
        self.image_paths = image_paths
        self.project_name = project_name
        self.project_manager = ProjectManager()
        
        self.current_image_index = 0
        self.image_points = {}
        self.current_cv_image = None
        self.current_photo = None
        
        # --- Config & State ---
        self.zoom_level = 1.0
        self.mode = tk.StringVar(value="points")
        self.num_clusters_var = tk.StringVar(value="10")
        
        # Area Selection State
        self.rect = None
        self.start_x = None
        self.start_y = None

        self.load_config()
        self._build_ui()
        self.load_image()

    def _build_ui(self):
        # 1. Top Bar: Image Navigation
        top_bar = ttk.Frame(self, padding=5, bootstyle="secondary")
        top_bar.pack(fill=X)
        
        ttk.Button(top_bar, text="<< Previous", command=self.prev_image, bootstyle="secondary-outline").pack(side=LEFT)
        
        self.image_label = ttk.Label(top_bar, text="", font=("Helvetica", 11, "bold"), bootstyle="inverse-secondary")
        self.image_label.pack(side=LEFT, expand=True) # Centers it due to pack mechanics if neighbors are fixed
        
        ttk.Button(top_bar, text="Next >>", command=self.next_image, bootstyle="secondary-outline").pack(side=RIGHT)

        # 2. Center: Canvas (The Studio)
        # Using a dark background frame to hold the canvas for that "Studio" feel
        canvas_container = ttk.Frame(self) 
        canvas_container.pack(fill=BOTH, expand=True)
        
        colors = self.app.get_current_colors() if self.app else {}
        bg_col = colors.get("canvas_bg", "#1e1e1e")
        
        self.canvas = tk.Canvas(canvas_container, bg=bg_col, highlightthickness=0)
        self.canvas.pack(fill=BOTH, expand=True)

        # 3. Bottom Control Panel (The Console)
        console = ttk.Frame(self, padding=10, bootstyle="light")
        console.pack(fill=X, side=BOTTOM)
        
        # Zone 1: Zoom
        z_frame = ttk.Labelframe(console, text="Zoom", padding=5)
        z_frame.pack(side=LEFT, padx=(0, 10), fill=Y)
        ttk.Button(z_frame, text="+", width=3, command=lambda: self._zoom(1.2)).pack(side=LEFT, padx=2)
        ttk.Button(z_frame, text="-", width=3, command=lambda: self._zoom(0.8)).pack(side=LEFT, padx=2)

        # Zone 2: Mode (Segmented Button Style)
        m_frame = ttk.Labelframe(console, text="Mode", padding=5)
        m_frame.pack(side=LEFT, padx=(0, 10), fill=Y)
        
        # Bootstyle 'toolbutton' behaves like a toggle/radio
        self.btn_mode_add = ttk.Radiobutton(m_frame, text="Add Points", variable=self.mode, value="points", bootstyle="primary-toolbutton", command=self._update_bindings)
        self.btn_mode_add.pack(side=LEFT, padx=2)
        
        self.btn_mode_del = ttk.Radiobutton(m_frame, text="Delete Point", variable=self.mode, value="delete", bootstyle="danger-toolbutton", command=self._update_bindings)
        self.btn_mode_del.pack(side=LEFT, padx=2)
        
        self.btn_mode_area = ttk.Radiobutton(m_frame, text="Select Area", variable=self.mode, value="area", bootstyle="info-toolbutton", command=self._update_bindings)
        self.btn_mode_area.pack(side=LEFT, padx=2)

        # Zone 3: Parameters (Cluster)
        p_frame = ttk.Labelframe(console, text="Parameters", padding=5)
        p_frame.pack(side=LEFT, padx=(0, 10), fill=Y)
        
        ttk.Label(p_frame, text="Clusters:").pack(side=LEFT)
        ttk.Entry(p_frame, textvariable=self.num_clusters_var, width=5).pack(side=LEFT, padx=5)
        
        ttk.Checkbutton(p_frame, text="Get Colors (Fast)", variable=self.mode, onvalue="getcolors", offvalue="area", bootstyle="round-toggle", command=self._update_bindings).pack(side=LEFT, padx=5)

        # Zone 4: Actions
        a_frame = ttk.Frame(console)
        a_frame.pack(side=RIGHT, fill=Y)
        
        ttk.Button(a_frame, text="Clear Image Points", command=self.clear_points, bootstyle="secondary-link").pack(side=LEFT, padx=10)
        ttk.Button(a_frame, text="Save & Close", command=self.save_and_close, bootstyle="success", width=15).pack(side=LEFT)

        self._update_bindings()

    def _update_bindings(self):
        self.canvas.unbind("<Button-1>")
        self.canvas.unbind("<ButtonPress-1>")
        self.canvas.unbind("<B1-Motion>")
        self.canvas.unbind("<ButtonRelease-1>")

        mode = self.mode.get()
        if mode == "points":
            self.canvas.config(cursor="cross")
            self.canvas.bind("<Button-1>", self._handle_point_click)
        elif mode in ["area", "getcolors"]:
            self.canvas.config(cursor="tcross")
            self.canvas.bind("<ButtonPress-1>", self._on_area_press)
            self.canvas.bind("<B1-Motion>", self._on_area_drag)
            self.canvas.bind("<ButtonRelease-1>", self._on_area_release)
        elif mode == "delete":
            self.canvas.config(cursor="X_cursor") # 'pirate' not always avail
            self.canvas.bind("<Button-1>", self._handle_delete_click)

        # Always enable Pan/Zoom
        self.canvas.bind("<Control-MouseWheel>", self._on_mouse_wheel)
        self.canvas.bind("<ButtonPress-2>", self._on_drag_start) # Middle click pan
        self.canvas.bind("<B2-Motion>", self._on_drag_motion)

    # --- Loading & Drawing Logic (Mostly Preserved) ---
    def load_config(self):
        try:
            config_data = self.project_manager._get_dataset_item_processing_config(self.project_name)
            for img_config in config_data.image_configs:
                if img_config.method == "points" and img_config.points:
                    self.image_points[img_config.filename] = [p.model_dump() for p in img_config.points]
        except Exception: pass

    def load_image(self):
        image_path = self.image_paths[self.current_image_index]
        self.image_label.config(text=f"Image {self.current_image_index + 1} / {len(self.image_paths)}: {os.path.basename(image_path)}")

        self.current_cv_image = cv2.imread(str(image_path))
        if self.current_cv_image is None: return

        # Fit to View (Approx)
        win_w, win_h = 1000, 700 # Approx workspace size
        h, w, _ = self.current_cv_image.shape
        self.zoom_level = min(win_w/w, win_h/h, 1.0) * 0.9

        self.redraw_canvas()

    def redraw_canvas(self):
        if self.current_cv_image is None: return
        self.canvas.delete("all")
        
        h, w, _ = self.current_cv_image.shape
        nw, nh = int(w * self.zoom_level), int(h * self.zoom_level)
        
        img_rgb = cv2.cvtColor(self.current_cv_image, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)
        pil_img = Image.fromarray(img_rgb).resize((nw, nh), Image.Resampling.BILINEAR)
        self.current_photo = ImageTk.PhotoImage(image=pil_img)
        
        # Center the image in the canvas if it's smaller than the canvas
        c_w = self.canvas.winfo_width()
        c_h = self.canvas.winfo_height()
        
        colors = self.app.get_current_colors() if self.app else {}
        bg_col = colors.get("canvas_bg", "#1e1e1e")
        self.canvas.config(bg=bg_col)
        
        x_offset = max(0, (c_w - nw) // 2)
        y_offset = max(0, (c_h - nh) // 2)

        self.canvas.config(scrollregion=(0, 0, max(nw, c_w), max(nh, c_h)))
        self.canvas.create_image(x_offset, y_offset, anchor=tk.NW, image=self.current_photo)
        
        self.draw_points(x_offset, y_offset)
        self.canvas_offset_x = x_offset
        self.canvas_offset_y = y_offset

    def draw_points(self, off_x, off_y):
        self.canvas.delete("point")
        fname = os.path.basename(self.image_paths[self.current_image_index])
        points = self.image_points.get(fname, [])
        
        colors = self.app.get_current_colors() if self.app else {}
        default_col = colors.get("canvas_point", "#00ff00")
        
        img_h, img_w = 0, 0
        if self.current_cv_image is not None:
            img_h, img_w = self.current_cv_image.shape[:2]
        
        for i, p in enumerate(points):
            cx = (p['x'] * self.zoom_level) + off_x
            cy = (p['y'] * self.zoom_level) + off_y
            r = p.get('radius', 7)
            
            fill_col = default_col
            if self.current_cv_image is not None:
                ix, iy = int(p['x']), int(p['y'])
                if 0 <= ix < img_w and 0 <= iy < img_h:
                    b, g, r_val = self.current_cv_image[iy, ix]
                    fill_col = f"#{int(r_val):02x}{int(g):02x}{int(b):02x}"

            self.canvas.create_oval(cx-r, cy-r, cx+r, cy+r, fill=fill_col, outline="black", width=2, tags=("point", f"p_{i}"))

    def _zoom(self, factor):
        self.zoom_level *= factor
        self.redraw_canvas()

    def _on_mouse_wheel(self, event):
        factor = 1.1 if (event.delta > 0 or event.num == 4) else 0.9
        self._zoom(factor)
        return "break"
    
    def _on_drag_start(self, event): self.canvas.scan_mark(event.x, event.y)
    def _on_drag_motion(self, event): self.canvas.scan_dragto(event.x, event.y, gain=1)

    # --- Interaction Logic ---
    def _to_img_coords(self, cx, cy):
        # Inverse of draw_points logic
        # cx = (img_x * zoom) + offset  => img_x = (cx - offset) / zoom
        ix = int((self.canvas.canvasx(cx) - getattr(self, 'canvas_offset_x', 0)) / self.zoom_level)
        iy = int((self.canvas.canvasy(cy) - getattr(self, 'canvas_offset_y', 0)) / self.zoom_level)
        return ix, iy

    def _handle_point_click(self, event):
        ix, iy = self._to_img_coords(event.x, event.y)
        fname = os.path.basename(self.image_paths[self.current_image_index])
        if fname not in self.image_points: self.image_points[fname] = []
        self.image_points[fname].append({"x": ix, "y": iy, "radius": 7})
        self.redraw_canvas()

    def _handle_delete_click(self, event):
        ix, iy = self._to_img_coords(event.x, event.y)
        fname = os.path.basename(self.image_paths[self.current_image_index])
        points = self.image_points.get(fname, [])
        if not points: return
        
        # Simple distance check
        for i, p in enumerate(points):
            dist = np.sqrt((p['x'] - ix)**2 + (p['y'] - iy)**2)
            if dist <= (p.get('radius', 7) / self.zoom_level) + 5: # Tolerance
                points.pop(i)
                self.redraw_canvas()
                break

    # --- Area Logic (Brief) ---
    def _on_area_press(self, e):
        self.start_x = self.canvas.canvasx(e.x)
        self.start_y = self.canvas.canvasy(e.y)
        if self.rect: self.canvas.delete(self.rect)
        self.rect = self.canvas.create_rectangle(self.start_x, self.start_y, self.start_x, self.start_y, outline='cyan', dash=(4,2))

    def _on_area_drag(self, e):
        cur_x, cur_y = self.canvas.canvasx(e.x), self.canvas.canvasy(e.y)
        self.canvas.coords(self.rect, self.start_x, self.start_y, cur_x, cur_y)

    def _on_area_release(self, e):
        if not self.rect: return
        x1, y1 = self._to_img_coords(min(self.start_x, self.canvas.canvasx(e.x)), min(self.start_y, self.canvas.canvasy(e.y)))
        x2, y2 = self._to_img_coords(max(self.start_x, self.canvas.canvasx(e.x)), max(self.start_y, self.canvas.canvasy(e.y)))
        
        self.canvas.delete(self.rect)
        self.rect = None
        
        if abs(x2-x1) > 5 and abs(y2-y1) > 5:
            if self.mode.get() == "area": self._perform_clustering(x1, y1, x2, y2)
            elif self.mode.get() == "getcolors": self._perform_getcolors(x1, y1, x2, y2)

    def _perform_clustering(self, x1, y1, x2, y2):
        # (Same logic as before, just ensuring integration)
        try: k = int(self.num_clusters_var.get())
        except: return
        roi = self.current_cv_image[y1:y2, x1:x2]
        if roi.size == 0: return
        pixels = roi.reshape(-1, 3).astype(np.float32)
        _, _, centers = cv2.kmeans(pixels, k, None, (cv2.TERM_CRITERIA_EPS + cv2.TERM_CRITERIA_MAX_ITER, 10, 1.0), 10, cv2.KMEANS_RANDOM_CENTERS)
        
        new_pts = []
        for c in centers:
            # Find closest pixel in ROI to this center color (simple heuristic for location)
            dists = np.linalg.norm(pixels - c, axis=1)
            idx = np.argmin(dists)
            ry, rx = np.unravel_index(idx, (roi.shape[0], roi.shape[1]))
            new_pts.append({"x": int(rx+x1), "y": int(ry+y1), "radius": 7})
            
        fname = os.path.basename(self.image_paths[self.current_image_index])
        if fname not in self.image_points: self.image_points[fname] = []
        self.image_points[fname].extend(new_pts)
        self.redraw_canvas()

    def _perform_getcolors(self, x1, y1, x2, y2):
        roi = self.current_cv_image[y1:y2, x1:x2]
        if roi.size == 0: return
        pil = Image.fromarray(cv2.cvtColor(roi, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB))
        cols = pil.getcolors(maxcolors=10000)
        if not cols: return
        
        # Simplistic mapping: just find first occurrence of each color
        # Optimized: Just scan ROI once
        seen = set()
        new_pts = []
        for r in range(roi.shape[0]):
            for c in range(roi.shape[1]):
                color = tuple(roi[r,c]) # BGR
                if color not in seen:
                    seen.add(color)
                    new_pts.append({"x": c+x1, "y": r+y1, "radius": 7})
        
        fname = os.path.basename(self.image_paths[self.current_image_index])
        if fname not in self.image_points: self.image_points[fname] = []
        self.image_points[fname].extend(new_pts)
        self.redraw_canvas()

    def next_image(self):
        if self.current_image_index < len(self.image_paths) - 1:
            self.current_image_index += 1
            self.load_image()
    
    def prev_image(self):
        if self.current_image_index > 0:
            self.current_image_index -= 1
            self.load_image()

    def clear_points(self):
        fname = os.path.basename(self.image_paths[self.current_image_index])
        self.image_points[fname] = []
        self.redraw_canvas()

    def save_and_close(self):
        try:
            for path in self.image_paths:
                fname = os.path.basename(path)
                pts = self.image_points.get(fname)
                if pts is not None:
                    self.project_manager.update_dataset_item_points(self.project_name, fname, pts)
            
            # Go back to empty state in parent tab
            self.destroy()
            messagebox.showinfo("Saved", "Configuration saved.")
        except Exception as e: messagebox.showerror("Error", str(e))

class DatasetManagerGUI(ttk.Frame):
    def __init__(self, master, image_paths: list, project_name: str, app=None):
        super().__init__(master)
        self.app = app
        self.image_paths = image_paths
        self.project_name = project_name
        self.project_manager = ProjectManager()
        
        self.current_image_index = 0
        self.image_points = {}
        self.current_cv_image = None
        self.blurred_cv_image = None
        self.current_photo = None
        
        # --- Config & State ---
        self.zoom_level = 1.0
        self.mode = tk.StringVar(value="points")
        self.num_clusters_var = tk.StringVar(value="10")
        self.blur_var = tk.DoubleVar(value=0)
        
        # Area Selection State
        self.rect = None
        self.start_x = None
        self.start_y = None
        
        self.selected_point_indices = []

        self.load_config()
        self._build_ui()
        self.load_image()

    def _build_ui(self):
        # 1. Top Bar: Image Navigation
        top_bar = ttk.Frame(self, padding=5, bootstyle="secondary")
        top_bar.pack(fill=X)
        
        ttk.Button(top_bar, text="<< Previous", command=self.prev_image, bootstyle="secondary-outline").pack(side=LEFT)
        
        self.image_label = ttk.Label(top_bar, text="", font=("Helvetica", 11, "bold"), bootstyle="inverse-secondary")
        self.image_label.pack(side=LEFT, expand=True) 
        
        ttk.Button(top_bar, text="Next >>", command=self.next_image, bootstyle="secondary-outline").pack(side=RIGHT)

        # 2. Main Split: Canvas (Left) + Side Panel (Right)
        main_split = ttk.Frame(self)
        main_split.pack(fill=BOTH, expand=True)

        # Canvas Container
        canvas_container = ttk.Frame(main_split) 
        canvas_container.pack(side=LEFT, fill=BOTH, expand=True)
        
        colors = self.app.get_current_colors() if self.app else {}
        bg_col = colors.get("canvas_bg", "#1e1e1e")
        
        self.canvas = tk.Canvas(canvas_container, bg=bg_col, highlightthickness=0)
        self.canvas.pack(fill=BOTH, expand=True)

        # Side Panel for Points
        side_panel = ttk.Frame(main_split, width=250, padding=5, bootstyle="light")
        side_panel.pack(side=RIGHT, fill=Y)
        
        ttk.Label(side_panel, text="Points List", font=("Helvetica", 10, "bold")).pack(pady=5)
        
        # Treeview
        self.tree = ttk.Treeview(side_panel, columns=("rgb",), show="headings", selectmode="extended")
        self.tree.heading("rgb", text="Color (RGB)")
        self.tree.column("rgb", width=150)
        
        # Scrollbar
        sb = ttk.Scrollbar(side_panel, orient=VERTICAL, command=self.tree.yview)
        self.tree.configure(yscrollcommand=sb.set)
        
        self.tree.pack(side=TOP, fill=BOTH, expand=True)
        sb.pack(side=RIGHT, fill=Y, in_=self.tree) # Pack scrollbar inside tree area visually
        
        self.tree.bind("<<TreeviewSelect>>", self._on_tree_select)
        
        ttk.Button(side_panel, text="Delete Selected", command=self._delete_selected_points, bootstyle="danger-outline").pack(fill=X, pady=5)


        # 3. Bottom Control Panel (The Console)
        console = ttk.Frame(self, padding=10, bootstyle="light")
        console.pack(fill=X, side=BOTTOM)
        
        # Zone 1: Zoom
        z_frame = ttk.Labelframe(console, text="Zoom", padding=5)
        z_frame.pack(side=LEFT, padx=(0, 10), fill=Y)
        ttk.Button(z_frame, text="+", width=3, command=lambda: self._zoom(1.2)).pack(side=LEFT, padx=2)
        ttk.Button(z_frame, text="-", width=3, command=lambda: self._zoom(0.8)).pack(side=LEFT, padx=2)

        # Zone 2: Mode
        m_frame = ttk.Labelframe(console, text="Mode", padding=5)
        m_frame.pack(side=LEFT, padx=(0, 10), fill=Y)
        
        self.btn_mode_add = ttk.Radiobutton(m_frame, text="Add Points", variable=self.mode, value="points", bootstyle="primary-toolbutton", command=self._update_bindings)
        self.btn_mode_add.pack(side=LEFT, padx=2)
        
        self.btn_mode_del = ttk.Radiobutton(m_frame, text="Delete Point", variable=self.mode, value="delete", bootstyle="danger-toolbutton", command=self._update_bindings)
        self.btn_mode_del.pack(side=LEFT, padx=2)
        
        self.btn_mode_area = ttk.Radiobutton(m_frame, text="Select Area", variable=self.mode, value="area", bootstyle="info-toolbutton", command=self._update_bindings)
        self.btn_mode_area.pack(side=LEFT, padx=2)

        # Zone 3: Blur Tool
        b_frame = ttk.Labelframe(console, text="Blur", padding=5)
        b_frame.pack(side=LEFT, padx=(0, 10), fill=Y)
        ttk.Scale(b_frame, from_=0, to=20, variable=self.blur_var, command=self._on_blur_change, length=100).pack(side=LEFT, padx=5)

        # Zone 4: Parameters (Cluster)
        p_frame = ttk.Labelframe(console, text="Parameters", padding=5)
        p_frame.pack(side=LEFT, padx=(0, 10), fill=Y)
        
        ttk.Label(p_frame, text="Clusters:").pack(side=LEFT)
        ttk.Entry(p_frame, textvariable=self.num_clusters_var, width=5).pack(side=LEFT, padx=5)
        
        ttk.Checkbutton(p_frame, text="Get Colors (Fast)", variable=self.mode, onvalue="getcolors", offvalue="area", bootstyle="round-toggle", command=self._update_bindings).pack(side=LEFT, padx=5)

        # Zone 5: Actions
        a_frame = ttk.Frame(console)
        a_frame.pack(side=RIGHT, fill=Y)
        
        ttk.Button(a_frame, text="Clear Image Points", command=self.clear_points, bootstyle="secondary-link").pack(side=LEFT, padx=10)
        ttk.Button(a_frame, text="Save & Close", command=self.save_and_close, bootstyle="success", width=15).pack(side=LEFT)

        self._update_bindings()

    def _update_bindings(self):
        self.canvas.unbind("<Button-1>")
        self.canvas.unbind("<ButtonPress-1>")
        self.canvas.unbind("<B1-Motion>")
        self.canvas.unbind("<ButtonRelease-1>")

        mode = self.mode.get()
        if mode == "points":
            self.canvas.config(cursor="cross")
            self.canvas.bind("<Button-1>", self._handle_point_click)
        elif mode in ["area", "getcolors"]:
            self.canvas.config(cursor="tcross")
            self.canvas.bind("<ButtonPress-1>", self._on_area_press)
            self.canvas.bind("<B1-Motion>", self._on_area_drag)
            self.canvas.bind("<ButtonRelease-1>", self._on_area_release)
        elif mode == "delete":
            self.canvas.config(cursor="X_cursor")
            self.canvas.bind("<Button-1>", self._handle_delete_click)

        # Always enable Pan/Zoom
        self.canvas.bind("<Control-MouseWheel>", self._on_mouse_wheel)
        self.canvas.bind("<ButtonPress-2>", self._on_drag_start) # Middle click pan
        self.canvas.bind("<B2-Motion>", self._on_drag_motion)

    # --- Loading & Drawing Logic ---
    def load_config(self):
        try:
            config_data = self.project_manager._get_dataset_item_processing_config(self.project_name)
            for img_config in config_data.image_configs:
                if img_config.method == "points" and img_config.points:
                    self.image_points[img_config.filename] = [p.model_dump() for p in img_config.points]
        except Exception: pass

    def load_image(self):
        image_path = self.image_paths[self.current_image_index]
        self.image_label.config(text=f"Image {self.current_image_index + 1} / {len(self.image_paths)}: {os.path.basename(image_path)}")

        self.current_cv_image = cv2.imread(str(image_path))
        if self.current_cv_image is None: return
        
        # Reset Blur
        self.blur_var.set(0)
        self.blurred_cv_image = self.current_cv_image.copy()

        # Fit to View (Approx)
        win_w, win_h = 1000, 700 
        h, w, _ = self.current_cv_image.shape
        self.zoom_level = min(win_w/w, win_h/h, 1.0) * 0.9

        self.redraw_canvas()
        self._update_point_list()

    def _on_blur_change(self, val):
        if self.current_cv_image is None: return
        k = int(float(val))
        if k % 2 == 0: k += 1 # Kernel size must be odd
        if k < 1: k = 1
        
        if k == 1:
            self.blurred_cv_image = self.current_cv_image.copy()
        else:
            self.blurred_cv_image = cv2.GaussianBlur(self.current_cv_image, (k, k), 0)
        
        self.redraw_canvas()
        self._update_point_list() # Colors might change if sampling from blurred image

    def redraw_canvas(self):
        if self.blurred_cv_image is None: return
        self.canvas.delete("all")
        
        h, w, _ = self.blurred_cv_image.shape
        nw, nh = int(w * self.zoom_level), int(h * self.zoom_level)
        
        img_rgb = cv2.cvtColor(self.blurred_cv_image, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)
        pil_img = Image.fromarray(img_rgb).resize((nw, nh), Image.Resampling.BILINEAR)
        self.current_photo = ImageTk.PhotoImage(image=pil_img)
        
        # Center the image
        c_w = self.canvas.winfo_width()
        c_h = self.canvas.winfo_height()
        
        colors = self.app.get_current_colors() if self.app else {}
        bg_col = colors.get("canvas_bg", "#1e1e1e")
        self.canvas.config(bg=bg_col)
        
        x_offset = max(0, (c_w - nw) // 2)
        y_offset = max(0, (c_h - nh) // 2)

        self.canvas.config(scrollregion=(0, 0, max(nw, c_w), max(nh, c_h)))
        self.canvas.create_image(x_offset, y_offset, anchor=tk.NW, image=self.current_photo)
        
        self.draw_points(x_offset, y_offset)
        self.canvas_offset_x = x_offset
        self.canvas_offset_y = y_offset

    def draw_points(self, off_x, off_y):
        self.canvas.delete("point")
        self.canvas.delete("selection_ring")
        
        fname = os.path.basename(self.image_paths[self.current_image_index])
        points = self.image_points.get(fname, [])
        
        colors = self.app.get_current_colors() if self.app else {}
        default_col = colors.get("canvas_point", "#00ff00")
        
        img_h, img_w = 0, 0
        if self.blurred_cv_image is not None:
            img_h, img_w = self.blurred_cv_image.shape[:2]
        
        for i, p in enumerate(points):
            cx = (p['x'] * self.zoom_level) + off_x
            cy = (p['y'] * self.zoom_level) + off_y
            r = p.get('radius', 7)
            
            fill_col = default_col
            if self.blurred_cv_image is not None:
                ix, iy = int(p['x']), int(p['y'])
                if 0 <= ix < img_w and 0 <= iy < img_h:
                    b, g, r_val = self.blurred_cv_image[iy, ix]
                    fill_col = f"#{int(r_val):02x}{int(g):02x}{int(b):02x}"

            self.canvas.create_oval(cx-r, cy-r, cx+r, cy+r, fill=fill_col, outline="black", width=2, tags=("point", f"p_{i}"))
            
            # Highlight selected
            if i in self.selected_point_indices:
                self.canvas.create_oval(cx-r-3, cy-r-3, cx+r+3, cy+r+3, outline="white", width=2, tags="selection_ring")

    def _update_point_list(self):
        # Clear
        for item in self.tree.get_children():
            self.tree.delete(item)
        
        fname = os.path.basename(self.image_paths[self.current_image_index])
        points = self.image_points.get(fname, [])
        
        img_h, img_w = 0, 0
        if self.blurred_cv_image is not None:
            img_h, img_w = self.blurred_cv_image.shape[:2]
        
        for i, p in enumerate(points):
            rgb_text = "N/A"
            if self.blurred_cv_image is not None:
                ix, iy = int(p['x']), int(p['y'])
                if 0 <= ix < img_w and 0 <= iy < img_h:
                    b, g, r = self.blurred_cv_image[iy, ix]
                    rgb_text = f"({r}, {g}, {b})"
            
            self.tree.insert("", "end", iid=str(i), values=(rgb_text,))

    def _on_tree_select(self, event):
        selected_items = self.tree.selection()
        self.selected_point_indices = [int(item) for item in selected_items]
        self.redraw_canvas()

    def _delete_selected_points(self):
        fname = os.path.basename(self.image_paths[self.current_image_index])
        points = self.image_points.get(fname, [])
        if not points: return
        
        # Sort indices in descending order to avoid index shifting issues
        indices_to_delete = sorted(self.selected_point_indices, reverse=True)
        
        for idx in indices_to_delete:
            if 0 <= idx < len(points):
                points.pop(idx)
        
        self.selected_point_indices = []
        self._update_point_list()
        self.redraw_canvas()

    def _zoom(self, factor):
        self.zoom_level *= factor
        self.redraw_canvas()

    def _on_mouse_wheel(self, event):
        factor = 1.1 if (event.delta > 0 or event.num == 4) else 0.9
        self._zoom(factor)
        return "break"
    
    def _on_drag_start(self, event): self.canvas.scan_mark(event.x, event.y)
    def _on_drag_motion(self, event): self.canvas.scan_dragto(event.x, event.y, gain=1)

    # --- Interaction Logic ---
    def _to_img_coords(self, cx, cy):
        # Inverse of draw_points logic
        # cx = (img_x * zoom) + offset  => img_x = (cx - offset) / zoom
        ix = int((self.canvas.canvasx(cx) - getattr(self, 'canvas_offset_x', 0)) / self.zoom_level)
        iy = int((self.canvas.canvasy(cy) - getattr(self, 'canvas_offset_y', 0)) / self.zoom_level)
        return ix, iy

    def _handle_point_click(self, event):
        ix, iy = self._to_img_coords(event.x, event.y)
        fname = os.path.basename(self.image_paths[self.current_image_index])
        if fname not in self.image_points: self.image_points[fname] = []
        self.image_points[fname].append({"x": ix, "y": iy, "radius": 7})
        self.redraw_canvas()
        self._update_point_list()

    def _handle_delete_click(self, event):
        ix, iy = self._to_img_coords(event.x, event.y)
        fname = os.path.basename(self.image_paths[self.current_image_index])
        points = self.image_points.get(fname, [])
        if not points: return
        
        # Simple distance check
        for i, p in enumerate(points):
            dist = np.sqrt((p['x'] - ix)**2 + (p['y'] - iy)**2)
            if dist <= (p.get('radius', 7) / self.zoom_level) + 5: # Tolerance
                points.pop(i)
                self.redraw_canvas()
                self._update_point_list()
                break

    # --- Area Logic (Brief) ---
    def _on_area_press(self, e):
        self.start_x = self.canvas.canvasx(e.x)
        self.start_y = self.canvas.canvasy(e.y)
        if self.rect: self.canvas.delete(self.rect)
        self.rect = self.canvas.create_rectangle(self.start_x, self.start_y, self.start_x, self.start_y, outline='cyan', dash=(4,2))

    def _on_area_drag(self, e):
        cur_x, cur_y = self.canvas.canvasx(e.x), self.canvas.canvasy(e.y)
        self.canvas.coords(self.rect, self.start_x, self.start_y, cur_x, cur_y)

    def _on_area_release(self, e):
        if not self.rect: return
        x1, y1 = self._to_img_coords(min(self.start_x, self.canvas.canvasx(e.x)), min(self.start_y, self.canvas.canvasy(e.y)))
        x2, y2 = self._to_img_coords(max(self.start_x, self.canvas.canvasx(e.x)), max(self.start_y, self.canvas.canvasy(e.y)))
        
        self.canvas.delete(self.rect)
        self.rect = None
        
        if abs(x2-x1) > 5 and abs(y2-y1) > 5:
            if self.mode.get() == "area": self._perform_clustering(x1, y1, x2, y2)
            elif self.mode.get() == "getcolors": self._perform_getcolors(x1, y1, x2, y2)

    def _perform_clustering(self, x1, y1, x2, y2):
        # (Same logic as before, just ensuring integration)
        try: k = int(self.num_clusters_var.get())
        except: return
        # USE BLURRED IMAGE FOR CLUSTERING IF USER WANTS "BLUR ACTING ON COLOR"
        roi = self.blurred_cv_image[y1:y2, x1:x2]
        if roi.size == 0: return
        pixels = roi.reshape(-1, 3).astype(np.float32)
        _, _, centers = cv2.kmeans(pixels, k, None, (cv2.TERM_CRITERIA_EPS + cv2.TERM_CRITERIA_MAX_ITER, 10, 1.0), 10, cv2.KMEANS_RANDOM_CENTERS)
        
        new_pts = []
        for c in centers:
            dists = np.linalg.norm(pixels - c, axis=1)
            idx = np.argmin(dists)
            ry, rx = np.unravel_index(idx, (roi.shape[0], roi.shape[1]))
            new_pts.append({"x": int(rx+x1), "y": int(ry+y1), "radius": 7})
            
        fname = os.path.basename(self.image_paths[self.current_image_index])
        if fname not in self.image_points: self.image_points[fname] = []
        self.image_points[fname].extend(new_pts)
        self.redraw_canvas()
        self._update_point_list()

    def _perform_getcolors(self, x1, y1, x2, y2):
        # USE BLURRED IMAGE
        roi = self.blurred_cv_image[y1:y2, x1:x2]
        if roi.size == 0: return
        pil = Image.fromarray(cv2.cvtColor(roi, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB))
        cols = pil.getcolors(maxcolors=10000)
        if not cols: return
        
        seen = set()
        new_pts = []
        for r in range(roi.shape[0]):
            for c in range(roi.shape[1]):
                color = tuple(roi[r,c]) # BGR
                if color not in seen:
                    seen.add(color)
                    new_pts.append({"x": c+x1, "y": r+y1, "radius": 7})
        
        fname = os.path.basename(self.image_paths[self.current_image_index])
        if fname not in self.image_points: self.image_points[fname] = []
        self.image_points[fname].extend(new_pts)
        self.redraw_canvas()
        self._update_point_list()

    def next_image(self):
        if self.current_image_index < len(self.image_paths) - 1:
            self.current_image_index += 1
            self.load_image()
    
    def prev_image(self):
        if self.current_image_index > 0:
            self.current_image_index -= 1
            self.load_image()

    def clear_points(self):
        fname = os.path.basename(self.image_paths[self.current_image_index])
        self.image_points[fname] = []
        self.redraw_canvas()
        self._update_point_list()

    def save_and_close(self):
        try:
            for path in self.image_paths:
                fname = os.path.basename(path)
                pts = self.image_points.get(fname)
                if pts is not None:
                    self.project_manager.update_dataset_item_points(self.project_name, fname, pts)
            
            self.destroy()
            messagebox.showinfo("Saved", "Configuration saved.")
        except Exception as e: messagebox.showerror("Error", str(e))

class DatasetManagerGUI(ttk.Frame):
    def __init__(self, master, image_paths: list, project_name: str, app=None):
        super().__init__(master)
        self.app = app
        self.image_paths = image_paths
        self.project_name = project_name
        self.project_manager = ProjectManager()
        
        self.current_image_index = 0
        self.image_points = {}
        self.current_cv_image = None
        self.current_photo = None
        
        # --- Config & State ---
        self.zoom_level = 1.0
        self.mode = tk.StringVar(value="points")
        self.num_clusters_var = tk.StringVar(value="10")
        
        # Area Selection State
        self.rect = None
        self.start_x = None
        self.start_y = None

        self.load_config()
        self._build_ui()
        self.load_image()

    def _build_ui(self):
        # 1. Top Bar: Image Navigation
        top_bar = ttk.Frame(self, padding=5, bootstyle="secondary")
        top_bar.pack(fill=X)
        
        ttk.Button(top_bar, text="<< Previous", command=self.prev_image, bootstyle="secondary-outline").pack(side=LEFT)
        
        self.image_label = ttk.Label(top_bar, text="", font=("Helvetica", 11, "bold"), bootstyle="inverse-secondary")
        self.image_label.pack(side=LEFT, expand=True) # Centers it due to pack mechanics if neighbors are fixed
        
        ttk.Button(top_bar, text="Next >>", command=self.next_image, bootstyle="secondary-outline").pack(side=RIGHT)

        # 2. Center: Canvas (The Studio)
        # Using a dark background frame to hold the canvas for that "Studio" feel
        canvas_container = ttk.Frame(self) 
        canvas_container.pack(fill=BOTH, expand=True)
        
        colors = self.app.get_current_colors() if self.app else {}
        bg_col = colors.get("canvas_bg", "#1e1e1e")
        
        self.canvas = tk.Canvas(canvas_container, bg=bg_col, highlightthickness=0)
        self.canvas.pack(fill=BOTH, expand=True)

        # 3. Bottom Control Panel (The Console)
        console = ttk.Frame(self, padding=10, bootstyle="light")
        console.pack(fill=X, side=BOTTOM)
        
        # Zone 1: Zoom
        z_frame = ttk.Labelframe(console, text="Zoom", padding=5)
        z_frame.pack(side=LEFT, padx=(0, 10), fill=Y)
        ttk.Button(z_frame, text="+", width=3, command=lambda: self._zoom(1.2)).pack(side=LEFT, padx=2)
        ttk.Button(z_frame, text="-", width=3, command=lambda: self._zoom(0.8)).pack(side=LEFT, padx=2)

        # Zone 2: Mode (Segmented Button Style)
        m_frame = ttk.Labelframe(console, text="Mode", padding=5)
        m_frame.pack(side=LEFT, padx=(0, 10), fill=Y)
        
        # Bootstyle 'toolbutton' behaves like a toggle/radio
        self.btn_mode_add = ttk.Radiobutton(m_frame, text="Add Points", variable=self.mode, value="points", bootstyle="primary-toolbutton", command=self._update_bindings)
        self.btn_mode_add.pack(side=LEFT, padx=2)
        
        self.btn_mode_del = ttk.Radiobutton(m_frame, text="Delete Point", variable=self.mode, value="delete", bootstyle="danger-toolbutton", command=self._update_bindings)
        self.btn_mode_del.pack(side=LEFT, padx=2)
        
        self.btn_mode_area = ttk.Radiobutton(m_frame, text="Select Area", variable=self.mode, value="area", bootstyle="info-toolbutton", command=self._update_bindings)
        self.btn_mode_area.pack(side=LEFT, padx=2)

        # Zone 3: Parameters (Cluster)
        p_frame = ttk.Labelframe(console, text="Parameters", padding=5)
        p_frame.pack(side=LEFT, padx=(0, 10), fill=Y)
        
        ttk.Label(p_frame, text="Clusters:").pack(side=LEFT)
        ttk.Entry(p_frame, textvariable=self.num_clusters_var, width=5).pack(side=LEFT, padx=5)
        
        ttk.Checkbutton(p_frame, text="Get Colors (Fast)", variable=self.mode, onvalue="getcolors", offvalue="area", bootstyle="round-toggle", command=self._update_bindings).pack(side=LEFT, padx=5)

        # Zone 4: Actions
        a_frame = ttk.Frame(console)
        a_frame.pack(side=RIGHT, fill=Y)
        
        ttk.Button(a_frame, text="Clear Image Points", command=self.clear_points, bootstyle="secondary-link").pack(side=LEFT, padx=10)
        ttk.Button(a_frame, text="Save & Close", command=self.save_and_close, bootstyle="success", width=15).pack(side=LEFT)

        self._update_bindings()

    def _update_bindings(self):
        self.canvas.unbind("<Button-1>")
        self.canvas.unbind("<ButtonPress-1>")
        self.canvas.unbind("<B1-Motion>")
        self.canvas.unbind("<ButtonRelease-1>")

        mode = self.mode.get()
        if mode == "points":
            self.canvas.config(cursor="cross")
            self.canvas.bind("<Button-1>", self._handle_point_click)
        elif mode in ["area", "getcolors"]:
            self.canvas.config(cursor="tcross")
            self.canvas.bind("<ButtonPress-1>", self._on_area_press)
            self.canvas.bind("<B1-Motion>", self._on_area_drag)
            self.canvas.bind("<ButtonRelease-1>", self._on_area_release)
        elif mode == "delete":
            self.canvas.config(cursor="X_cursor") # 'pirate' not always avail
            self.canvas.bind("<Button-1>", self._handle_delete_click)

        # Always enable Pan/Zoom
        self.canvas.bind("<Control-MouseWheel>", self._on_mouse_wheel)
        self.canvas.bind("<ButtonPress-2>", self._on_drag_start) # Middle click pan
        self.canvas.bind("<B2-Motion>", self._on_drag_motion)

    # --- Loading & Drawing Logic (Mostly Preserved) ---
    def load_config(self):
        try:
            config_data = self.project_manager._get_dataset_item_processing_config(self.project_name)
            for img_config in config_data.image_configs:
                if img_config.method == "points" and img_config.points:
                    self.image_points[img_config.filename] = [p.model_dump() for p in img_config.points]
        except Exception: pass

    def load_image(self):
        image_path = self.image_paths[self.current_image_index]
        self.image_label.config(text=f"Image {self.current_image_index + 1} / {len(self.image_paths)}: {os.path.basename(image_path)}")

        self.current_cv_image = cv2.imread(str(image_path))
        if self.current_cv_image is None: return

        # Fit to View (Approx)
        win_w, win_h = 1000, 700 # Approx workspace size
        h, w, _ = self.current_cv_image.shape
        self.zoom_level = min(win_w/w, win_h/h, 1.0) * 0.9

        self.redraw_canvas()

    def redraw_canvas(self):
        if self.current_cv_image is None: return
        self.canvas.delete("all")
        
        h, w, _ = self.current_cv_image.shape
        nw, nh = int(w * self.zoom_level), int(h * self.zoom_level)
        
        img_rgb = cv2.cvtColor(self.current_cv_image, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)
        pil_img = Image.fromarray(img_rgb).resize((nw, nh), Image.Resampling.BILINEAR)
        self.current_photo = ImageTk.PhotoImage(image=pil_img)
        
        # Center the image in the canvas if it's smaller than the canvas
        c_w = self.canvas.winfo_width()
        c_h = self.canvas.winfo_height()
        
        colors = self.app.get_current_colors() if self.app else {}
        bg_col = colors.get("canvas_bg", "#1e1e1e")
        self.canvas.config(bg=bg_col)
        
        x_offset = max(0, (c_w - nw) // 2)
        y_offset = max(0, (c_h - nh) // 2)

        self.canvas.config(scrollregion=(0, 0, max(nw, c_w), max(nh, c_h)))
        self.canvas.create_image(x_offset, y_offset, anchor=tk.NW, image=self.current_photo)
        
        self.draw_points(x_offset, y_offset)
        self.canvas_offset_x = x_offset
        self.canvas_offset_y = y_offset

    def draw_points(self, off_x, off_y):
        self.canvas.delete("point")
        fname = os.path.basename(self.image_paths[self.current_image_index])
        points = self.image_points.get(fname, [])
        
        colors = self.app.get_current_colors() if self.app else {}
        default_col = colors.get("canvas_point", "#00ff00")
        
        img_h, img_w = 0, 0
        if self.current_cv_image is not None:
            img_h, img_w = self.current_cv_image.shape[:2]
        
        for i, p in enumerate(points):
            cx = (p['x'] * self.zoom_level) + off_x
            cy = (p['y'] * self.zoom_level) + off_y
            r = p.get('radius', 7)
            
            fill_col = default_col
            if self.current_cv_image is not None:
                ix, iy = int(p['x']), int(p['y'])
                if 0 <= ix < img_w and 0 <= iy < img_h:
                    b, g, r_val = self.current_cv_image[iy, ix]
                    fill_col = f"#{int(r_val):02x}{int(g):02x}{int(b):02x}"

            self.canvas.create_oval(cx-r, cy-r, cx+r, cy+r, fill=fill_col, outline="black", width=2, tags=("point", f"p_{i}"))

    def _zoom(self, factor):
        self.zoom_level *= factor
        self.redraw_canvas()

    def _on_mouse_wheel(self, event):
        factor = 1.1 if (event.delta > 0 or event.num == 4) else 0.9
        self._zoom(factor)
        return "break"
    
    def _on_drag_start(self, event): self.canvas.scan_mark(event.x, event.y)
    def _on_drag_motion(self, event): self.canvas.scan_dragto(event.x, event.y, gain=1)

    # --- Interaction Logic ---
    def _to_img_coords(self, cx, cy):
        # Inverse of draw_points logic
        # cx = (img_x * zoom) + offset  => img_x = (cx - offset) / zoom
        ix = int((self.canvas.canvasx(cx) - getattr(self, 'canvas_offset_x', 0)) / self.zoom_level)
        iy = int((self.canvas.canvasy(cy) - getattr(self, 'canvas_offset_y', 0)) / self.zoom_level)
        return ix, iy

    def _handle_point_click(self, event):
        ix, iy = self._to_img_coords(event.x, event.y)
        fname = os.path.basename(self.image_paths[self.current_image_index])
        if fname not in self.image_points: self.image_points[fname] = []
        self.image_points[fname].append({"x": ix, "y": iy, "radius": 7})
        self.redraw_canvas()

    def _handle_delete_click(self, event):
        ix, iy = self._to_img_coords(event.x, event.y)
        fname = os.path.basename(self.image_paths[self.current_image_index])
        points = self.image_points.get(fname, [])
        if not points: return
        
        # Simple distance check
        for i, p in enumerate(points):
            dist = np.sqrt((p['x'] - ix)**2 + (p['y'] - iy)**2)
            if dist <= (p.get('radius', 7) / self.zoom_level) + 5: # Tolerance
                points.pop(i)
                self.redraw_canvas()
                break

    # --- Area Logic (Brief) ---
    def _on_area_press(self, e):
        self.start_x = self.canvas.canvasx(e.x)
        self.start_y = self.canvas.canvasy(e.y)
        if self.rect: self.canvas.delete(self.rect)
        self.rect = self.canvas.create_rectangle(self.start_x, self.start_y, self.start_x, self.start_y, outline='cyan', dash=(4,2))

    def _on_area_drag(self, e):
        cur_x, cur_y = self.canvas.canvasx(e.x), self.canvas.canvasy(e.y)
        self.canvas.coords(self.rect, self.start_x, self.start_y, cur_x, cur_y)

    def _on_area_release(self, e):
        if not self.rect: return
        x1, y1 = self._to_img_coords(min(self.start_x, self.canvas.canvasx(e.x)), min(self.start_y, self.canvas.canvasy(e.y)))
        x2, y2 = self._to_img_coords(max(self.start_x, self.canvas.canvasx(e.x)), max(self.start_y, self.canvas.canvasy(e.y)))
        
        self.canvas.delete(self.rect)
        self.rect = None
        
        if abs(x2-x1) > 5 and abs(y2-y1) > 5:
            if self.mode.get() == "area": self._perform_clustering(x1, y1, x2, y2)
            elif self.mode.get() == "getcolors": self._perform_getcolors(x1, y1, x2, y2)

    def _perform_clustering(self, x1, y1, x2, y2):
        # (Same logic as before, just ensuring integration)
        try: k = int(self.num_clusters_var.get())
        except: return
        roi = self.current_cv_image[y1:y2, x1:x2]
        if roi.size == 0: return
        pixels = roi.reshape(-1, 3).astype(np.float32)
        _, _, centers = cv2.kmeans(pixels, k, None, (cv2.TERM_CRITERIA_EPS + cv2.TERM_CRITERIA_MAX_ITER, 10, 1.0), 10, cv2.KMEANS_RANDOM_CENTERS)
        
        new_pts = []
        for c in centers:
            # Find closest pixel in ROI to this center color (simple heuristic for location)
            dists = np.linalg.norm(pixels - c, axis=1)
            idx = np.argmin(dists)
            ry, rx = np.unravel_index(idx, (roi.shape[0], roi.shape[1]))
            new_pts.append({"x": int(rx+x1), "y": int(ry+y1), "radius": 7})
            
        fname = os.path.basename(self.image_paths[self.current_image_index])
        if fname not in self.image_points: self.image_points[fname] = []
        self.image_points[fname].extend(new_pts)
        self.redraw_canvas()

    def _perform_getcolors(self, x1, y1, x2, y2):
        roi = self.current_cv_image[y1:y2, x1:x2]
        if roi.size == 0: return
        pil = Image.fromarray(cv2.cvtColor(roi, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB))
        cols = pil.getcolors(maxcolors=10000)
        if not cols: return
        
        # Simplistic mapping: just find first occurrence of each color
        # Optimized: Just scan ROI once
        seen = set()
        new_pts = []
        for r in range(roi.shape[0]):
            for c in range(roi.shape[1]):
                color = tuple(roi[r,c]) # BGR
                if color not in seen:
                    seen.add(color)
                    new_pts.append({"x": c+x1, "y": r+y1, "radius": 7})
        
        fname = os.path.basename(self.image_paths[self.current_image_index])
        if fname not in self.image_points: self.image_points[fname] = []
        self.image_points[fname].extend(new_pts)
        self.redraw_canvas()

    def next_image(self):
        if self.current_image_index < len(self.image_paths) - 1:
            self.current_image_index += 1
            self.load_image()
    
    def prev_image(self):
        if self.current_image_index > 0:
            self.current_image_index -= 1
            self.load_image()

    def clear_points(self):
        fname = os.path.basename(self.image_paths[self.current_image_index])
        self.image_points[fname] = []
        self.redraw_canvas()

    def save_and_close(self):
        try:
            for path in self.image_paths:
                fname = os.path.basename(path)
                pts = self.image_points.get(fname)
                if pts is not None:
                    self.project_manager.update_dataset_item_points(self.project_name, fname, pts)
            
            # Go back to empty state in parent tab
            self.destroy()
            messagebox.showinfo("Saved", "Configuration saved.")
        except Exception as e: messagebox.showerror("Error", str(e))

from ttkbootstrap.constants import *
import os
import cv2
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageTk

from src.project_management.manager import ProjectManager

class DatasetManagerGUI(ttk.Frame):
    def __init__(self, master, image_paths: list, project_name: str, app=None):
        super().__init__(master)

        self.current_image_index = 0

        # --- Config & State ---
        self.zoom_level = 1.0

        # Area Selection State
        self.rect = None
        self.start_x = None
        self.start_y = None
        
        self.selected_point_indices = []

        self.load_config()
        self._build_ui()
        self.load_image()

    def _build_ui(self):
        # 1. Top Bar: Image Navigation
        top_bar = ttk.Frame(self, padding=5, bootstyle="secondary")
