        # 2. Main Split: Canvas (Left) + Side Panel (Right)
        main_split = ttk.Frame(self)
        main_split.pack(fill=BOTH, expand=True)

        # Canvas Container
        canvas_container = ttk.Frame(main_split) 
        canvas_container.pack(side=LEFT, fill=BOTH, expand=True)
        
        colors = self.app.get_current_colors() if self.app else {}
        bg_col = colors.get("canvas_bg", "#1e1e1e")
        
        self.canvas = tk.Canvas(canvas_container, bg=bg_col, highlightthickness=0)
        self.canvas.pack(fill=BOTH, expand=True)

        # Side Panel for Points
        side_panel = ttk.Frame(main_split, width=250, padding=5, bootstyle="light")
        side_panel.pack(side=RIGHT, fill=Y)
        
        ttk.Label(side_panel, text="Points List", font=("Helvetica", 10, "bold")).pack(pady=5)
        
        # Treeview
        self.tree = ttk.Treeview(side_panel, columns=("rgb",), show="headings", selectmode="extended")
        self.tree.heading("rgb", text="Color (RGB)")
        self.tree.column("rgb", width=150)
        
        # Scrollbar
        sb = ttk.Scrollbar(side_panel, orient=VERTICAL, command=self.tree.yview)
        self.tree.configure(yscrollcommand=sb.set)
        
        self.tree.pack(side=TOP, fill=BOTH, expand=True)
        sb.pack(side=RIGHT, fill=Y, in_=self.tree) # Pack scrollbar inside tree area visually
        
        self.tree.bind("<<TreeviewSelect>>", self._on_tree_select)
        
        ttk.Button(side_panel, text="Delete Selected", command=self._delete_selected_points, bootstyle="danger-outline").pack(fill=X, pady=5)


        # 3. Bottom Control Panel (The Console)
        console = ttk.Frame(self, padding=10, bootstyle="light")
        console.pack(fill=X, side=BOTTOM)
        
        # Zone 1: Zoom
        z_frame = ttk.Labelframe(console, text="Zoom", padding=5)
        z_frame.pack(side=LEFT, padx=(0, 10), fill=Y)
        ttk.Button(z_frame, text="+", width=3, command=lambda: self._zoom(1.2)).pack(side=LEFT, padx=2)
        ttk.Button(z_frame, text="-", width=3, command=lambda: self._zoom(0.8)).pack(side=LEFT, padx=2)

        # Zone 2: Mode
        m_frame = ttk.Labelframe(console, text="Mode", padding=5)
        m_frame.pack(side=LEFT, padx=(0, 10), fill=Y)
        
        self.btn_mode_add = ttk.Radiobutton(m_frame, text="Add Points", variable=self.mode, value="points", bootstyle="primary-toolbutton", command=self._update_bindings)
        self.btn_mode_add.pack(side=LEFT, padx=2)
        
        self.btn_mode_del = ttk.Radiobutton(m_frame, text="Delete Point", variable=self.mode, value="delete", bootstyle="danger-toolbutton", command=self._update_bindings)
        self.btn_mode_del.pack(side=LEFT, padx=2)
        
        self.btn_mode_area = ttk.Radiobutton(m_frame, text="Select Area", variable=self.mode, value="area", bootstyle="info-toolbutton", command=self._update_bindings)
        self.btn_mode_area.pack(side=LEFT, padx=2)

        # Zone 3: Blur Tool
        b_frame = ttk.Labelframe(console, text="Blur", padding=5)
        b_frame.pack(side=LEFT, padx=(0, 10), fill=Y)
        ttk.Scale(b_frame, from_=0, to=20, variable=self.blur_var, command=self._on_blur_change, length=100).pack(side=LEFT, padx=5)

        # Zone 4: Parameters (Cluster)
        p_frame = ttk.Labelframe(console, text="Parameters", padding=5)
        p_frame.pack(side=LEFT, padx=(0, 10), fill=Y)
        
        ttk.Label(p_frame, text="Clusters:").pack(side=LEFT)
        ttk.Entry(p_frame, textvariable=self.num_clusters_var, width=5).pack(side=LEFT, padx=5)
        
        ttk.Checkbutton(p_frame, text="Get Colors (Fast)", variable=self.mode, onvalue="getcolors", offvalue="area", bootstyle="round-toggle", command=self._update_bindings).pack(side=LEFT, padx=5)

        # Zone 5: Actions
        a_frame = ttk.Frame(console)
        a_frame.pack(side=RIGHT, fill=Y)
        
        ttk.Button(a_frame, text="Clear Image Points", command=self.clear_points, bootstyle="secondary-link").pack(side=LEFT, padx=10)
        ttk.Button(a_frame, text="Save & Close", command=self.save_and_close, bootstyle="success", width=15).pack(side=LEFT)

        self._update_bindings()

    def _update_bindings(self):
        self.canvas.unbind("<Button-1>")
        self.canvas.unbind("<ButtonPress-1>")
        self.canvas.unbind("<B1-Motion>")
        self.canvas.unbind("<ButtonRelease-1>")

        mode = self.mode.get()
        if mode == "points":
            self.canvas.config(cursor="cross")
            self.canvas.bind("<Button-1>", self._handle_point_click)
        elif mode in ["area", "getcolors"]:
            self.canvas.config(cursor="tcross")
            self.canvas.bind("<ButtonPress-1>", self._on_area_press)
            self.canvas.bind("<B1-Motion>", self._on_area_drag)
            self.canvas.bind("<ButtonRelease-1>", self._on_area_release)
        elif mode == "delete":
            self.canvas.config(cursor="X_cursor")
            self.canvas.bind("<Button-1>", self._handle_delete_click)

        # Always enable Pan/Zoom
        self.canvas.bind("<Control-MouseWheel>", self._on_mouse_wheel)
        self.canvas.bind("<ButtonPress-2>", self._on_drag_start) # Middle click pan
        self.canvas.bind("<B2-Motion>", self._on_drag_motion)

    # --- Loading & Drawing Logic ---
    def load_config(self):
        try:
            config_data = self.project_manager._get_dataset_item_processing_config(self.project_name)
            for img_config in config_data.image_configs:
                if img_config.method == "points" and img_config.points:
                    self.image_points[img_config.filename] = [p.model_dump() for p in img_config.points]
        except Exception: pass

    def load_image(self):
        image_path = self.image_paths[self.current_image_index]
        self.image_label.config(text=f"Image {self.current_image_index + 1} / {len(self.image_paths)}: {os.path.basename(image_path)}")

        self.current_cv_image = cv2.imread(str(image_path))
        if self.current_cv_image is None: return
        
        # Reset Blur
        self.blur_var.set(0)
        self.blurred_cv_image = self.current_cv_image.copy()

        # Fit to View (Approx)
        win_w, win_h = 1000, 700 
        h, w, _ = self.current_cv_image.shape
        self.zoom_level = min(win_w/w, win_h/h, 1.0) * 0.9

        self.redraw_canvas()
        self._update_point_list()

    def _on_blur_change(self, val):
        if self.current_cv_image is None: return
        k = int(float(val))
        if k % 2 == 0: k += 1 # Kernel size must be odd
        if k < 1: k = 1
        
        if k == 1:
            self.blurred_cv_image = self.current_cv_image.copy()
        else:
            self.blurred_cv_image = cv2.GaussianBlur(self.current_cv_image, (k, k), 0)
        
        self.redraw_canvas()
        self._update_point_list() # Colors might change if sampling from blurred image

    def redraw_canvas(self):
        if self.blurred_cv_image is None: return
        self.canvas.delete("all")
        
        h, w, _ = self.blurred_cv_image.shape
        nw, nh = int(w * self.zoom_level), int(h * self.zoom_level)
        
        img_rgb = cv2.cvtColor(self.blurred_cv_image, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)
        pil_img = Image.fromarray(img_rgb).resize((nw, nh), Image.Resampling.BILINEAR)
        self.current_photo = ImageTk.PhotoImage(image=pil_img)
        
        # Center the image
        c_w = self.canvas.winfo_width()
        c_h = self.canvas.winfo_height()
        
        colors = self.app.get_current_colors() if self.app else {}
        bg_col = colors.get("canvas_bg", "#1e1e1e")
        self.canvas.config(bg=bg_col)
        
        x_offset = max(0, (c_w - nw) // 2)
        y_offset = max(0, (c_h - nh) // 2)

        self.canvas.config(scrollregion=(0, 0, max(nw, c_w), max(nh, c_h)))
        self.canvas.create_image(x_offset, y_offset, anchor=tk.NW, image=self.current_photo)
        
        self.draw_points(x_offset, y_offset)
        self.canvas_offset_x = x_offset
        self.canvas_offset_y = y_offset

    def draw_points(self, off_x, off_y):
        self.canvas.delete("point")
        self.canvas.delete("selection_ring")
        
        fname = os.path.basename(self.image_paths[self.current_image_index])
        points = self.image_points.get(fname, [])
        
        colors = self.app.get_current_colors() if self.app else {}
        default_col = colors.get("canvas_point", "#00ff00")
        
        img_h, img_w = 0, 0
        if self.blurred_cv_image is not None:
            img_h, img_w = self.blurred_cv_image.shape[:2]
        
        for i, p in enumerate(points):
            cx = (p['x'] * self.zoom_level) + off_x
            cy = (p['y'] * self.zoom_level) + off_y
            r = p.get('radius', 7)
            
            fill_col = default_col
            if self.blurred_cv_image is not None:
                ix, iy = int(p['x']), int(p['y'])
                if 0 <= ix < img_w and 0 <= iy < img_h:
                    b, g, r_val = self.blurred_cv_image[iy, ix]
                    fill_col = f"#{int(r_val):02x}{int(g):02x}{int(b):02x}"

            self.canvas.create_oval(cx-r, cy-r, cx+r, cy+r, fill=fill_col, outline="black", width=2, tags=("point", f"p_{i}"))
            
            # Highlight selected
            if i in self.selected_point_indices:
                self.canvas.create_oval(cx-r-3, cy-r-3, cx+r+3, cy+r+3, outline="white", width=2, tags="selection_ring")

    def _update_point_list(self):
        # Clear
        for item in self.tree.get_children():
            self.tree.delete(item)
        
        fname = os.path.basename(self.image_paths[self.current_image_index])
        points = self.image_points.get(fname, [])
        
        img_h, img_w = 0, 0
        if self.blurred_cv_image is not None:
            img_h, img_w = self.blurred_cv_image.shape[:2]
        
        for i, p in enumerate(points):
            rgb_text = "N/A"
            if self.blurred_cv_image is not None:
                ix, iy = int(p['x']), int(p['y'])
                if 0 <= ix < img_w and 0 <= iy < img_h:
                    b, g, r = self.blurred_cv_image[iy, ix]
                    rgb_text = f"({r}, {g}, {b})"
            
            self.tree.insert("", "end", iid=str(i), values=(rgb_text,))

    def _on_tree_select(self, event):
        selected_items = self.tree.selection()
        self.selected_point_indices = [int(item) for item in selected_items]
        self.redraw_canvas()

    def _delete_selected_points(self):
        fname = os.path.basename(self.image_paths[self.current_image_index])
        points = self.image_points.get(fname, [])
        if not points: return
        
        # Sort indices in descending order to avoid index shifting issues
        indices_to_delete = sorted(self.selected_point_indices, reverse=True)
        
        for idx in indices_to_delete:
            if 0 <= idx < len(points):
                points.pop(idx)
        
        self.selected_point_indices = []
        self._update_point_list()
        self.redraw_canvas()

    def _zoom(self, factor):
        self.zoom_level *= factor
        self.redraw_canvas()

    def _on_mouse_wheel(self, event):
        factor = 1.1 if (event.delta > 0 or event.num == 4) else 0.9
        self._zoom(factor)
        return "break"
    
    def _on_drag_start(self, event): self.canvas.scan_mark(event.x, event.y)
    def _on_drag_motion(self, event): self.canvas.scan_dragto(event.x, event.y, gain=1)

    # --- Interaction Logic ---
    def _to_img_coords(self, cx, cy):
        # Inverse of draw_points logic
        # cx = (img_x * zoom) + offset  => img_x = (cx - offset) / zoom
        ix = int((self.canvas.canvasx(cx) - getattr(self, 'canvas_offset_x', 0)) / self.zoom_level)
        iy = int((self.canvas.canvasy(cy) - getattr(self, 'canvas_offset_y', 0)) / self.zoom_level)
        return ix, iy

    def _handle_point_click(self, event):
        ix, iy = self._to_img_coords(event.x, event.y)
        fname = os.path.basename(self.image_paths[self.current_image_index])
        if fname not in self.image_points: self.image_points[fname] = []
        self.image_points[fname].append({"x": ix, "y": iy, "radius": 7})
        self.redraw_canvas()
        self._update_point_list()

    def _handle_delete_click(self, event):
        ix, iy = self._to_img_coords(event.x, event.y)
        fname = os.path.basename(self.image_paths[self.current_image_index])
        points = self.image_points.get(fname, [])
        if not points: return
        
        # Simple distance check
        for i, p in enumerate(points):
            dist = np.sqrt((p['x'] - ix)**2 + (p['y'] - iy)**2)
            if dist <= (p.get('radius', 7) / self.zoom_level) + 5: # Tolerance
                points.pop(i)
                self.redraw_canvas()
                self._update_point_list()
                break

    # --- Area Logic (Brief) ---
    def _on_area_press(self, e):
        self.start_x = self.canvas.canvasx(e.x)
        self.start_y = self.canvas.canvasy(e.y)
        if self.rect: self.canvas.delete(self.rect)
        self.rect = self.canvas.create_rectangle(self.start_x, self.start_y, self.start_x, self.start_y, outline='cyan', dash=(4,2))

    def _on_area_drag(self, e):
        cur_x, cur_y = self.canvas.canvasx(e.x), self.canvas.canvasy(e.y)
        self.canvas.coords(self.rect, self.start_x, self.start_y, cur_x, cur_y)

    def _on_area_release(self, e):
        if not self.rect: return
        x1, y1 = self._to_img_coords(min(self.start_x, self.canvas.canvasx(e.x)), min(self.start_y, self.canvas.canvasy(e.y)))
        x2, y2 = self._to_img_coords(max(self.start_x, self.canvas.canvasx(e.x)), max(self.start_y, self.canvas.canvasy(e.y)))
        
        self.canvas.delete(self.rect)
        self.rect = None
        
        if abs(x2-x1) > 5 and abs(y2-y1) > 5:
            if self.mode.get() == "area": self._perform_clustering(x1, y1, x2, y2)
            elif self.mode.get() == "getcolors": self._perform_getcolors(x1, y1, x2, y2)

    def _perform_clustering(self, x1, y1, x2, y2):
        # (Same logic as before, just ensuring integration)
        try: k = int(self.num_clusters_var.get())
        except: return
        # USE BLURRED IMAGE FOR CLUSTERING IF USER WANTS "BLUR ACTING ON COLOR"
        roi = self.blurred_cv_image[y1:y2, x1:x2]
        if roi.size == 0: return
        pixels = roi.reshape(-1, 3).astype(np.float32)
        _, _, centers = cv2.kmeans(pixels, k, None, (cv2.TERM_CRITERIA_EPS + cv2.TERM_CRITERIA_MAX_ITER, 10, 1.0), 10, cv2.KMEANS_RANDOM_CENTERS)
        
        new_pts = []
        for c in centers:
            dists = np.linalg.norm(pixels - c, axis=1)
            idx = np.argmin(dists)
            ry, rx = np.unravel_index(idx, (roi.shape[0], roi.shape[1]))
            new_pts.append({"x": int(rx+x1), "y": int(ry+y1), "radius": 7})
            
        fname = os.path.basename(self.image_paths[self.current_image_index])
        if fname not in self.image_points: self.image_points[fname] = []
        self.image_points[fname].extend(new_pts)
        self.redraw_canvas()
        self._update_point_list()

    def _perform_getcolors(self, x1, y1, x2, y2):
        # USE BLURRED IMAGE
        roi = self.blurred_cv_image[y1:y2, x1:x2]
        if roi.size == 0: return
        pil = Image.fromarray(cv2.cvtColor(roi, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB))
        cols = pil.getcolors(maxcolors=10000)
        if not cols: return
        
        seen = set()
        new_pts = []
        for r in range(roi.shape[0]):
            for c in range(roi.shape[1]):
                color = tuple(roi[r,c]) # BGR
                if color not in seen:
                    seen.add(color)
                    new_pts.append({"x": c+x1, "y": r+y1, "radius": 7})
        
        fname = os.path.basename(self.image_paths[self.current_image_index])
        if fname not in self.image_points: self.image_points[fname] = []
        self.image_points[fname].extend(new_pts)
        self.redraw_canvas()
        self._update_point_list()

    def next_image(self):
        if self.current_image_index < len(self.image_paths) - 1:
            self.current_image_index += 1
            self.load_image()
    
    def prev_image(self):
        if self.current_image_index > 0:
            self.current_image_index -= 1
            self.load_image()

    def clear_points(self):
        fname = os.path.basename(self.image_paths[self.current_image_index])
        self.image_points[fname] = []
        self.redraw_canvas()
        self._update_point_list()

    def save_and_close(self):
        try:
            for path in self.image_paths:
                fname = os.path.basename(path)
                pts = self.image_points.get(fname)
                if pts is not None:
                    self.project_manager.update_dataset_item_points(self.project_name, fname, pts)
            
            self.destroy()
            messagebox.showinfo("Saved", "Configuration saved.")
        except Exception as e: messagebox.showerror("Error", str(e))

        self.tree.heading("rgb", text="Color (RGB)")
        self.tree.column("rgb", width=150)
        
        # Scrollbar
        sb = ttk.Scrollbar(side_panel, orient=VERTICAL, command=self.tree.yview)
        self.tree.configure(yscrollcommand=sb.set)
        
        self.tree.pack(side=TOP, fill=BOTH, expand=True)
        sb.pack(side=RIGHT, fill=Y, in_=self.tree) # Pack scrollbar inside tree area visually
        
        self.tree.bind("<<TreeviewSelect>>", self._on_tree_select)
        
        ttk.Button(side_panel, text="Delete Selected", command=self._delete_selected_points, bootstyle="danger-outline").pack(fill=X, pady=5)


        # 3. Bottom Control Panel (The Console)
        console = ttk.Frame(self, padding=10, bootstyle="light")
        console.pack(fill=X, side=BOTTOM)
        
        # Zone 1: Zoom
        z_frame = ttk.Labelframe(console, text="Zoom", padding=5)
        z_frame.pack(side=LEFT, padx=(0, 10), fill=Y)
        ttk.Button(z_frame, text="+", width=3, command=lambda: self._zoom(1.2)).pack(side=LEFT, padx=2)
        ttk.Button(z_frame, text="-", width=3, command=lambda: self._zoom(0.8)).pack(side=LEFT, padx=2)

        # Zone 2: Mode
        m_frame = ttk.Labelframe(console, text="Mode", padding=5)
        m_frame.pack(side=LEFT, padx=(0, 10), fill=Y)
        
        self.btn_mode_add = ttk.Radiobutton(m_frame, text="Add Points", variable=self.mode, value="points", bootstyle="primary-toolbutton", command=self._update_bindings)
        self.btn_mode_add.pack(side=LEFT, padx=2)
        
        self.btn_mode_del = ttk.Radiobutton(m_frame, text="Delete Point", variable=self.mode, value="delete", bootstyle="danger-toolbutton", command=self._update_bindings)
        self.btn_mode_del.pack(side=LEFT, padx=2)
        
        self.btn_mode_area = ttk.Radiobutton(m_frame, text="Select Area", variable=self.mode, value="area", bootstyle="info-toolbutton", command=self._update_bindings)
        self.btn_mode_area.pack(side=LEFT, padx=2)

        # Zone 3: Blur Tool
        b_frame = ttk.Labelframe(console, text="Blur", padding=5)
        b_frame.pack(side=LEFT, padx=(0, 10), fill=Y)
        ttk.Scale(b_frame, from_=0, to=20, variable=self.blur_var, command=self._on_blur_change, length=100).pack(side=LEFT, padx=5)

        # Zone 4: Parameters (Cluster)
        p_frame = ttk.Labelframe(console, text="Parameters", padding=5)
        p_frame.pack(side=LEFT, padx=(0, 10), fill=Y)
        
        ttk.Label(p_frame, text="Clusters:").pack(side=LEFT)
        ttk.Entry(p_frame, textvariable=self.num_clusters_var, width=5).pack(side=LEFT, padx=5)
        
        ttk.Checkbutton(p_frame, text="Get Colors (Fast)", variable=self.mode, onvalue="getcolors", offvalue="area", bootstyle="round-toggle", command=self._update_bindings).pack(side=LEFT, padx=5)

        # Zone 5: Actions
        a_frame = ttk.Frame(console)
        a_frame.pack(side=RIGHT, fill=Y)
        
        ttk.Button(a_frame, text="Clear Image Points", command=self.clear_points, bootstyle="secondary-link").pack(side=LEFT, padx=10)
        ttk.Button(a_frame, text="Save & Close", command=self.save_and_close, bootstyle="success", width=15).pack(side=LEFT)

        self._update_bindings()

    def _update_bindings(self):
        self.canvas.unbind("<Button-1>")
        self.canvas.unbind("<ButtonPress-1>")
        self.canvas.unbind("<B1-Motion>")
        self.canvas.unbind("<ButtonRelease-1>")

        mode = self.mode.get()
        if mode == "points":
            self.canvas.config(cursor="cross")
            self.canvas.bind("<Button-1>", self._handle_point_click)
        elif mode in ["area", "getcolors"]:
            self.canvas.config(cursor="tcross")
            self.canvas.bind("<ButtonPress-1>", self._on_area_press)
            self.canvas.bind("<B1-Motion>", self._on_area_drag)
            self.canvas.bind("<ButtonRelease-1>", self._on_area_release)
        elif mode == "delete":
            self.canvas.config(cursor="X_cursor")
            self.canvas.bind("<Button-1>", self._handle_delete_click)

        # Always enable Pan/Zoom
        self.canvas.bind("<Control-MouseWheel>", self._on_mouse_wheel)
        self.canvas.bind("<ButtonPress-2>", self._on_drag_start) # Middle click pan
        self.canvas.bind("<B2-Motion>", self._on_drag_motion)

    # --- Loading & Drawing Logic ---
    def load_config(self):
        try:
            config_data = self.project_manager._get_dataset_item_processing_config(self.project_name)
            for img_config in config_data.image_configs:
                if img_config.method == "points" and img_config.points:
                    self.image_points[img_config.filename] = [p.model_dump() for p in img_config.points]
        except Exception: pass

    def load_image(self):
        image_path = self.image_paths[self.current_image_index]
        self.image_label.config(text=f"Image {self.current_image_index + 1} / {len(self.image_paths)}: {os.path.basename(image_path)}")

        self.current_cv_image = cv2.imread(str(image_path))
        if self.current_cv_image is None: return
        
        # Reset Blur
        self.blur_var.set(0)
        self.blurred_cv_image = self.current_cv_image.copy()

        # Fit to View (Approx)
        win_w, win_h = 1000, 700 
        h, w, _ = self.current_cv_image.shape
        self.zoom_level = min(win_w/w, win_h/h, 1.0) * 0.9

        self.redraw_canvas()
        self._update_point_list()

    def _on_blur_change(self, val):
        if self.current_cv_image is None: return
        k = int(float(val))
        if k % 2 == 0: k += 1 # Kernel size must be odd
        if k < 1: k = 1
        
        if k == 1:
            self.blurred_cv_image = self.current_cv_image.copy()
        else:
            self.blurred_cv_image = cv2.GaussianBlur(self.current_cv_image, (k, k), 0)
        
        self.redraw_canvas()
        self._update_point_list() # Colors might change if sampling from blurred image

    def redraw_canvas(self):
        if self.blurred_cv_image is None: return
        self.canvas.delete("all")
        
        h, w, _ = self.blurred_cv_image.shape
        nw, nh = int(w * self.zoom_level), int(h * self.zoom_level)
        
        img_rgb = cv2.cvtColor(self.blurred_cv_image, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)
        pil_img = Image.fromarray(img_rgb).resize((nw, nh), Image.Resampling.BILINEAR)
        self.current_photo = ImageTk.PhotoImage(image=pil_img)
        
        # Center the image
        c_w = self.canvas.winfo_width()
        c_h = self.canvas.winfo_height()
        
        colors = self.app.get_current_colors() if self.app else {}
        bg_col = colors.get("canvas_bg", "#1e1e1e")
        self.canvas.config(bg=bg_col)
        
        x_offset = max(0, (c_w - nw) // 2)
        y_offset = max(0, (c_h - nh) // 2)

        self.canvas.config(scrollregion=(0, 0, max(nw, c_w), max(nh, c_h)))
        self.canvas.create_image(x_offset, y_offset, anchor=tk.NW, image=self.current_photo)
        
        self.draw_points(x_offset, y_offset)
        self.canvas_offset_x = x_offset
        self.canvas_offset_y = y_offset

    def draw_points(self, off_x, off_y):
        self.canvas.delete("point")
        self.canvas.delete("selection_ring")
        
        fname = os.path.basename(self.image_paths[self.current_image_index])
        points = self.image_points.get(fname, [])
        
        colors = self.app.get_current_colors() if self.app else {}
        default_col = colors.get("canvas_point", "#00ff00")
        
        img_h, img_w = 0, 0
        if self.blurred_cv_image is not None:
            img_h, img_w = self.blurred_cv_image.shape[:2]
        
        for i, p in enumerate(points):
            cx = (p['x'] * self.zoom_level) + off_x
            cy = (p['y'] * self.zoom_level) + off_y
            r = p.get('radius', 7)
            
            fill_col = default_col
            if self.blurred_cv_image is not None:
                ix, iy = int(p['x']), int(p['y'])
                if 0 <= ix < img_w and 0 <= iy < img_h:
                    b, g, r_val = self.blurred_cv_image[iy, ix]
                    fill_col = f"#{int(r_val):02x}{int(g):02x}{int(b):02x}"

            self.canvas.create_oval(cx-r, cy-r, cx+r, cy+r, fill=fill_col, outline="black", width=2, tags=("point", f"p_{i}"))
            
            # Highlight selected
            if i in self.selected_point_indices:
                self.canvas.create_oval(cx-r-3, cy-r-3, cx+r+3, cy+r+3, outline="white", width=2, tags="selection_ring")

    def _update_point_list(self):
        # Clear
        for item in self.tree.get_children():
            self.tree.delete(item)
        
        fname = os.path.basename(self.image_paths[self.current_image_index])
        points = self.image_points.get(fname, [])
        
        img_h, img_w = 0, 0
        if self.blurred_cv_image is not None:
            img_h, img_w = self.blurred_cv_image.shape[:2]
        
        for i, p in enumerate(points):
            rgb_text = "N/A"
            hex_col = "#333333" # Default
            fg_col = "white"

            if self.blurred_cv_image is not None:
                ix, iy = int(p['x']), int(p['y'])
                if 0 <= ix < img_w and 0 <= iy < img_h:
                    b, g, r = self.blurred_cv_image[iy, ix]
                    rgb_text = f"({r}, {g}, {b})"
                    hex_col = f"#{int(r):02x}{int(g):02x}{int(b):02x}"
                    
                    # Simple brightness for text contrast
                    brightness = (int(r) * 299 + int(g) * 587 + int(b) * 114) / 1000
                    fg_col = "black" if brightness > 128 else "white"
            
            tag_name = f"row_{i}"
            self.tree.insert("", "end", iid=str(i), values=(rgb_text,), tags=(tag_name,))
            self.tree.tag_configure(tag_name, background=hex_col, foreground=fg_col)

    def _on_tree_select(self, event):
        selected_items = self.tree.selection()
        self.selected_point_indices = [int(item) for item in selected_items]
        self.redraw_canvas()

    def _delete_selected_points(self):
        fname = os.path.basename(self.image_paths[self.current_image_index])
        points = self.image_points.get(fname, [])
        if not points: return
        
        # Sort indices in descending order to avoid index shifting issues
        indices_to_delete = sorted(self.selected_point_indices, reverse=True)
        
        for idx in indices_to_delete:
            if 0 <= idx < len(points):
                points.pop(idx)
        
        self.selected_point_indices = []
        self._update_point_list()
        self.redraw_canvas()

    def _zoom(self, factor):
        self.zoom_level *= factor
        self.redraw_canvas()

    def _on_mouse_wheel(self, event):
        factor = 1.1 if (event.delta > 0 or event.num == 4) else 0.9
        self._zoom(factor)
        return "break"
    
    def _on_drag_start(self, event): self.canvas.scan_mark(event.x, event.y)
    def _on_drag_motion(self, event): self.canvas.scan_dragto(event.x, event.y, gain=1)

    # --- Interaction Logic ---
    def _to_img_coords(self, cx, cy):
        # Inverse of draw_points logic
        # cx = (img_x * zoom) + offset  => img_x = (cx - offset) / zoom
        ix = int((self.canvas.canvasx(cx) - getattr(self, 'canvas_offset_x', 0)) / self.zoom_level)
        iy = int((self.canvas.canvasy(cy) - getattr(self, 'canvas_offset_y', 0)) / self.zoom_level)
        return ix, iy

    def _handle_point_click(self, event):
        ix, iy = self._to_img_coords(event.x, event.y)
        fname = os.path.basename(self.image_paths[self.current_image_index])
        if fname not in self.image_points: self.image_points[fname] = []
        self.image_points[fname].append({"x": ix, "y": iy, "radius": 7})
        self.redraw_canvas()
        self._update_point_list()

    def _handle_delete_click(self, event):
        ix, iy = self._to_img_coords(event.x, event.y)
        fname = os.path.basename(self.image_paths[self.current_image_index])
        points = self.image_points.get(fname, [])
        if not points: return
        
        # Simple distance check
        for i, p in enumerate(points):
            dist = np.sqrt((p['x'] - ix)**2 + (p['y'] - iy)**2)
            if dist <= (p.get('radius', 7) / self.zoom_level) + 5: # Tolerance
                points.pop(i)
                self.redraw_canvas()
                self._update_point_list()
                break

    # --- Area Logic (Brief) ---
    def _on_area_press(self, e):
        self.start_x = self.canvas.canvasx(e.x)
        self.start_y = self.canvas.canvasy(e.y)
        if self.rect: self.canvas.delete(self.rect)
        self.rect = self.canvas.create_rectangle(self.start_x, self.start_y, self.start_x, self.start_y, outline='cyan', dash=(4,2))

    def _on_area_drag(self, e):
        cur_x, cur_y = self.canvas.canvasx(e.x), self.canvas.canvasy(e.y)
        self.canvas.coords(self.rect, self.start_x, self.start_y, cur_x, cur_y)

    def _on_area_release(self, e):
        if not self.rect: return
        x1, y1 = self._to_img_coords(min(self.start_x, self.canvas.canvasx(e.x)), min(self.start_y, self.canvas.canvasy(e.y)))
        x2, y2 = self._to_img_coords(max(self.start_x, self.canvas.canvasx(e.x)), max(self.start_y, self.canvas.canvasy(e.y)))
        
        self.canvas.delete(self.rect)
        self.rect = None
        
        if abs(x2-x1) > 5 and abs(y2-y1) > 5:
            if self.mode.get() == "area": self._perform_clustering(x1, y1, x2, y2)
            elif self.mode.get() == "getcolors": self._perform_getcolors(x1, y1, x2, y2)

    def _perform_clustering(self, x1, y1, x2, y2):
        # (Same logic as before, just ensuring integration)
        try: k = int(self.num_clusters_var.get())
        except: return
        # USE BLURRED IMAGE FOR CLUSTERING IF USER WANTS "BLUR ACTING ON COLOR"
        roi = self.blurred_cv_image[y1:y2, x1:x2]
        if roi.size == 0: return
        pixels = roi.reshape(-1, 3).astype(np.float32)
        _, _, centers = cv2.kmeans(pixels, k, None, (cv2.TERM_CRITERIA_EPS + cv2.TERM_CRITERIA_MAX_ITER, 10, 1.0), 10, cv2.KMEANS_RANDOM_CENTERS)
        
        new_pts = []
        for c in centers:
            dists = np.linalg.norm(pixels - c, axis=1)
            idx = np.argmin(dists)
            ry, rx = np.unravel_index(idx, (roi.shape[0], roi.shape[1]))
            new_pts.append({"x": int(rx+x1), "y": int(ry+y1), "radius": 7})
            
        fname = os.path.basename(self.image_paths[self.current_image_index])
        if fname not in self.image_points: self.image_points[fname] = []
        self.image_points[fname].extend(new_pts)
        self.redraw_canvas()
        self._update_point_list()

    def _perform_getcolors(self, x1, y1, x2, y2):
        # USE BLURRED IMAGE
        roi = self.blurred_cv_image[y1:y2, x1:x2]
        if roi.size == 0: return
        pil = Image.fromarray(cv2.cvtColor(roi, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB))
        cols = pil.getcolors(maxcolors=10000)
        if not cols: return
        
        seen = set()
        new_pts = []
        for r in range(roi.shape[0]):
            for c in range(roi.shape[1]):
                color = tuple(roi[r,c]) # BGR
                if color not in seen:
                    seen.add(color)
                    new_pts.append({"x": c+x1, "y": r+y1, "radius": 7})
        
        fname = os.path.basename(self.image_paths[self.current_image_index])
        if fname not in self.image_points: self.image_points[fname] = []
        self.image_points[fname].extend(new_pts)
        self.redraw_canvas()
        self._update_point_list()

    def next_image(self):
        if self.current_image_index < len(self.image_paths) - 1:
            self.current_image_index += 1
            self.load_image()
    
    def prev_image(self):
        if self.current_image_index > 0:
            self.current_image_index -= 1
            self.load_image()

    def clear_points(self):
        fname = os.path.basename(self.image_paths[self.current_image_index])
        self.image_points[fname] = []
        self.redraw_canvas()
        self._update_point_list()

    def save_and_close(self):
        try:
            for path in self.image_paths:
                fname = os.path.basename(path)
                pts = self.image_points.get(fname)
                if pts is not None:
                    self.project_manager.update_dataset_item_points(self.project_name, fname, pts)
            
            self.destroy()
            messagebox.showinfo("Saved", "Configuration saved.")
        except Exception as e: messagebox.showerror("Error", str(e))

I have fixed the layout issue in the Tkinter GUI.

### Fix Details

    def _update_bindings(self):
        self.canvas.unbind("<Button-1>")
        self.canvas.unbind("<ButtonPress-1>")
        self.canvas.unbind("<B1-Motion>")
        self.canvas.unbind("<ButtonRelease-1>")

        mode = self.mode.get()
        if mode == "points":
            self.canvas.config(cursor="cross")
            self.canvas.bind("<Button-1>", self._handle_point_click)
        elif mode in ["area", "getcolors"]:
            self.canvas.config(cursor="tcross")
            self.canvas.bind("<ButtonPress-1>", self._on_area_press)
            self.canvas.bind("<B1-Motion>", self._on_area_drag)
            self.canvas.bind("<ButtonRelease-1>", self._on_area_release)
        elif mode == "delete":
            self.canvas.config(cursor="X_cursor")
            self.canvas.bind("<Button-1>", self._handle_delete_click)

        # Always enable Pan/Zoom
        self.canvas.bind("<Control-MouseWheel>", self._on_mouse_wheel)
        self.canvas.bind("<ButtonPress-2>", self._on_drag_start) # Middle click pan
        self.canvas.bind("<B2-Motion>", self._on_drag_motion)

    # --- Loading & Drawing Logic ---
    def load_config(self):
        try:
            config_data = self.project_manager._get_dataset_item_processing_config(self.project_name)
            for img_config in config_data.image_configs:
                if img_config.method == "points" and img_config.points:
                    self.image_points[img_config.filename] = [p.model_dump() for p in img_config.points]
        except Exception: pass

    def load_image(self):
        image_path = self.image_paths[self.current_image_index]
        self.image_label.config(text=f"Image {self.current_image_index + 1} / {len(self.image_paths)}: {os.path.basename(image_path)}")

        self.current_cv_image = cv2.imread(str(image_path))
        if self.current_cv_image is None: return
        
        # Reset Blur
        self.blur_var.set(0)
        self.blurred_cv_image = self.current_cv_image.copy()

        # Fit to View (Approx)
        win_w, win_h = 1000, 700 
        h, w, _ = self.current_cv_image.shape
        self.zoom_level = min(win_w/w, win_h/h, 1.0) * 0.9

        self.redraw_canvas()
        self._update_point_list()

    def _on_blur_change(self, val):
        if self.current_cv_image is None: return
        k = int(float(val))
        if k % 2 == 0: k += 1 # Kernel size must be odd
        if k < 1: k = 1
        
        if k == 1:
            self.blurred_cv_image = self.current_cv_image.copy()
        else:
            self.blurred_cv_image = cv2.GaussianBlur(self.current_cv_image, (k, k), 0)
        
        self.redraw_canvas()
        self._update_point_list() # Colors might change if sampling from blurred image

    def redraw_canvas(self):
        if self.blurred_cv_image is None: return
        self.canvas.delete("all")
        
        h, w, _ = self.blurred_cv_image.shape
        nw, nh = int(w * self.zoom_level), int(h * self.zoom_level)
        
        img_rgb = cv2.cvtColor(self.blurred_cv_image, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)
        pil_img = Image.fromarray(img_rgb).resize((nw, nh), Image.Resampling.BILINEAR)
        self.current_photo = ImageTk.PhotoImage(image=pil_img)
        
        # Center the image
        c_w = self.canvas.winfo_width()
        c_h = self.canvas.winfo_height()
        
        colors = self.app.get_current_colors() if self.app else {}
        bg_col = colors.get("canvas_bg", "#1e1e1e")
        self.canvas.config(bg=bg_col)
        
        x_offset = max(0, (c_w - nw) // 2)
        y_offset = max(0, (c_h - nh) // 2)

        self.canvas.config(scrollregion=(0, 0, max(nw, c_w), max(nh, c_h)))
        self.canvas.create_image(x_offset, y_offset, anchor=tk.NW, image=self.current_photo)
        
        self.draw_points(x_offset, y_offset)
        self.canvas_offset_x = x_offset
        self.canvas_offset_y = y_offset

    def draw_points(self, off_x, off_y):
        self.canvas.delete("point")
        self.canvas.delete("selection_ring")
        
        fname = os.path.basename(self.image_paths[self.current_image_index])
        points = self.image_points.get(fname, [])
        
        colors = self.app.get_current_colors() if self.app else {}
        default_col = colors.get("canvas_point", "#00ff00")
        
        img_h, img_w = 0, 0
        if self.blurred_cv_image is not None:
            img_h, img_w = self.blurred_cv_image.shape[:2]
        
        for i, p in enumerate(points):
            cx = (p['x'] * self.zoom_level) + off_x
            cy = (p['y'] * self.zoom_level) + off_y
            r = p.get('radius', 7)
            
            fill_col = default_col
            if self.blurred_cv_image is not None:
                ix, iy = int(p['x']), int(p['y'])
                if 0 <= ix < img_w and 0 <= iy < img_h:
                    b, g, r_val = self.blurred_cv_image[iy, ix]
                    fill_col = f"#{int(r_val):02x}{int(g):02x}{int(b):02x}"

            self.canvas.create_oval(cx-r, cy-r, cx+r, cy+r, fill=fill_col, outline="black", width=2, tags=("point", f"p_{i}"))
            
            # Highlight selected
            if i in self.selected_point_indices:
                self.canvas.create_oval(cx-r-3, cy-r-3, cx+r+3, cy+r+3, outline="white", width=2, tags="selection_ring")

    def _update_point_list(self):
        # Clear
        for item in self.tree.get_children():
            self.tree.delete(item)
        
        fname = os.path.basename(self.image_paths[self.current_image_index])
        points = self.image_points.get(fname, [])
        
        img_h, img_w = 0, 0
        if self.blurred_cv_image is not None:
            img_h, img_w = self.blurred_cv_image.shape[:2]
        
        for i, p in enumerate(points):
            rgb_text = "N/A"
            hex_col = "#333333" # Default
            fg_col = "white"

            if self.blurred_cv_image is not None:
                ix, iy = int(p['x']), int(p['y'])
                if 0 <= ix < img_w and 0 <= iy < img_h:
                    b, g, r = self.blurred_cv_image[iy, ix]
                    rgb_text = f"({r}, {g}, {b})"
                    hex_col = f"#{int(r):02x}{int(g):02x}{int(b):02x}"
                    
                    # Simple brightness for text contrast
                    brightness = (int(r) * 299 + int(g) * 587 + int(b) * 114) / 1000
                    fg_col = "black" if brightness > 128 else "white"
            
            tag_name = f"row_{i}"
            self.tree.insert("", "end", iid=str(i), values=(rgb_text,), tags=(tag_name,))
            self.tree.tag_configure(tag_name, background=hex_col, foreground=fg_col)

    def _on_tree_select(self, event):
        selected_items = self.tree.selection()
        self.selected_point_indices = [int(item) for item in selected_items]
        self.redraw_canvas()

    def _delete_selected_points(self):
        fname = os.path.basename(self.image_paths[self.current_image_index])
        points = self.image_points.get(fname, [])
        if not points: return
        
        # Sort indices in descending order to avoid index shifting issues
        indices_to_delete = sorted(self.selected_point_indices, reverse=True)
        
        for idx in indices_to_delete:
            if 0 <= idx < len(points):
                points.pop(idx)
        
        self.selected_point_indices = []
        self._update_point_list()
        self.redraw_canvas()

    def _zoom(self, factor):
        self.zoom_level *= factor
        self.redraw_canvas()

    def _on_mouse_wheel(self, event):
        factor = 1.1 if (event.delta > 0 or event.num == 4) else 0.9
        self._zoom(factor)
        return "break"
    
    def _on_drag_start(self, event): self.canvas.scan_mark(event.x, event.y)
    def _on_drag_motion(self, event): self.canvas.scan_dragto(event.x, event.y, gain=1)

    # --- Interaction Logic ---
    def _to_img_coords(self, cx, cy):
        # Inverse of draw_points logic
        # cx = (img_x * zoom) + offset  => img_x = (cx - offset) / zoom
        ix = int((self.canvas.canvasx(cx) - getattr(self, 'canvas_offset_x', 0)) / self.zoom_level)
        iy = int((self.canvas.canvasy(cy) - getattr(self, 'canvas_offset_y', 0)) / self.zoom_level)
        return ix, iy

    def _handle_point_click(self, event):
        ix, iy = self._to_img_coords(event.x, event.y)
        fname = os.path.basename(self.image_paths[self.current_image_index])
        if fname not in self.image_points: self.image_points[fname] = []
        self.image_points[fname].append({"x": ix, "y": iy, "radius": 7})
        self.redraw_canvas()
        self._update_point_list()

    def _handle_delete_click(self, event):
        ix, iy = self._to_img_coords(event.x, event.y)
        fname = os.path.basename(self.image_paths[self.current_image_index])
        points = self.image_points.get(fname, [])
        if not points: return
        
        # Simple distance check
        for i, p in enumerate(points):
            dist = np.sqrt((p['x'] - ix)**2 + (p['y'] - iy)**2)
            if dist <= (p.get('radius', 7) / self.zoom_level) + 5: # Tolerance
                points.pop(i)
                self.redraw_canvas()
                self._update_point_list()
                break

    # --- Area Logic (Brief) ---
    def _on_area_press(self, e):
        self.start_x = self.canvas.canvasx(e.x)
        self.start_y = self.canvas.canvasy(e.y)
        if self.rect: self.canvas.delete(self.rect)
        self.rect = self.canvas.create_rectangle(self.start_x, self.start_y, self.start_x, self.start_y, outline='cyan', dash=(4,2))

    def _on_area_drag(self, e):
        cur_x, cur_y = self.canvas.canvasx(e.x), self.canvas.canvasy(e.y)
        self.canvas.coords(self.rect, self.start_x, self.start_y, cur_x, cur_y)

    def _on_area_release(self, e):
        if not self.rect: return
        x1, y1 = self._to_img_coords(min(self.start_x, self.canvas.canvasx(e.x)), min(self.start_y, self.canvas.canvasy(e.y)))
        x2, y2 = self._to_img_coords(max(self.start_x, self.canvas.canvasx(e.x)), max(self.start_y, self.canvas.canvasy(e.y)))
        
        self.canvas.delete(self.rect)
        self.rect = None
        
        if abs(x2-x1) > 5 and abs(y2-y1) > 5:
            if self.mode.get() == "area": self._perform_clustering(x1, y1, x2, y2)
            elif self.mode.get() == "getcolors": self._perform_getcolors(x1, y1, x2, y2)

    def _perform_clustering(self, x1, y1, x2, y2):
        # (Same logic as before, just ensuring integration)
        try: k = int(self.num_clusters_var.get())
        except: return
        # USE BLURRED IMAGE FOR CLUSTERING IF USER WANTS "BLUR ACTING ON COLOR"
        roi = self.blurred_cv_image[y1:y2, x1:x2]
        if roi.size == 0: return
        pixels = roi.reshape(-1, 3).astype(np.float32)
        _, _, centers = cv2.kmeans(pixels, k, None, (cv2.TERM_CRITERIA_EPS + cv2.TERM_CRITERIA_MAX_ITER, 10, 1.0), 10, cv2.KMEANS_RANDOM_CENTERS)
        
        new_pts = []
        for c in centers:
            dists = np.linalg.norm(pixels - c, axis=1)
            idx = np.argmin(dists)
            ry, rx = np.unravel_index(idx, (roi.shape[0], roi.shape[1]))
            new_pts.append({"x": int(rx+x1), "y": int(ry+y1), "radius": 7})
            
        fname = os.path.basename(self.image_paths[self.current_image_index])
        if fname not in self.image_points: self.image_points[fname] = []
        self.image_points[fname].extend(new_pts)
        self.redraw_canvas()
        self._update_point_list()

    def _perform_getcolors(self, x1, y1, x2, y2):
        # USE BLURRED IMAGE
        roi = self.blurred_cv_image[y1:y2, x1:x2]
        if roi.size == 0: return
        pil = Image.fromarray(cv2.cvtColor(roi, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB))
        cols = pil.getcolors(maxcolors=10000)
        if not cols: return
        
        seen = set()
        new_pts = []
        for r in range(roi.shape[0]):
            for c in range(roi.shape[1]):
                color = tuple(roi[r,c]) # BGR
                if color not in seen:
                    seen.add(color)
                    new_pts.append({"x": c+x1, "y": r+y1, "radius": 7})
        
        fname = os.path.basename(self.image_paths[self.current_image_index])
        if fname not in self.image_points: self.image_points[fname] = []
        self.image_points[fname].extend(new_pts)
        self.redraw_canvas()
        self._update_point_list()

    def next_image(self):
        if self.current_image_index < len(self.image_paths) - 1:
            self.current_image_index += 1
            self.load_image()
    
    def prev_image(self):
        if self.current_image_index > 0:
            self.current_image_index -= 1
            self.load_image()

    def clear_points(self):
        fname = os.path.basename(self.image_paths[self.current_image_index])
        self.image_points[fname] = []
        self.redraw_canvas()
        self._update_point_list()

    def save_and_close(self):
        try:
            for path in self.image_paths:
                fname = os.path.basename(path)
                pts = self.image_points.get(fname)
                if pts is not None:
                    self.project_manager.update_dataset_item_points(self.project_name, fname, pts)
            
            self.destroy()
            messagebox.showinfo("Saved", "Configuration saved.")
        except Exception as e: messagebox.showerror("Error", str(e))

            self.canvas.bind("<ButtonRelease-1>", self._on_area_release)
        elif mode == "delete":

        # Always enable Pan/Zoom

        # Fit to View (Approx)

        if k == 1:
            self.blurred_cv_image = self.current_cv_image.copy()
        else:
            self.blurred_cv_image = cv2.GaussianBlur(self.current_cv_image, (k, k), 0)
        
        self.redraw_canvas()
        self._update_point_list() # Colors might change if sampling from blurred image

        if self.blurred_cv_image is None: return

        nw, nh = int(w * self.zoom_level), int(h * self.zoom_level)
        
        img_rgb = cv2.cvtColor(self.blurred_cv_image, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)

        colors = self.app.get_current_colors() if self.app else {}
        bg_col = colors.get("canvas_bg", "#1e1e1e")

        x_offset = max(0, (c_w - nw) // 2)

        self.canvas.config(scrollregion=(0, 0, max(nw, c_w), max(nh, c_h)))

        default_col = colors.get("canvas_point", "#00ff00")
        
        img_h, img_w = 0, 0
        if self.blurred_cv_image is not None:
            img_h, img_w = self.blurred_cv_image.shape[:2]
        
        for i, p in enumerate(points):
            cx = (p['x'] * self.zoom_level) + off_x

            r = p.get('radius', 7)
            
            fill_col = default_col
            if self.blurred_cv_image is not None:
                ix, iy = int(p['x']), int(p['y'])
                if 0 <= ix < img_w and 0 <= iy < img_h:
                    b, g, r_val = self.blurred_cv_image[iy, ix]
                    fill_col = f"#{int(r_val):02x}{int(g):02x}{int(b):02x}"

            self.canvas.create_oval(cx-r, cy-r, cx+r, cy+r, fill=fill_col, outline="black", width=2, tags=("point", f"p_{i}"))
            
            # Highlight selected

                if 0 <= ix < img_w and 0 <= iy < img_h:
                    b, g, r = self.blurred_cv_image[iy, ix]
                    rgb_text = f"({r}, {g}, {b})"
                    hex_col = f"#{int(r):02x}{int(g):02x}{int(b):02x}"
                    
                    # Simple brightness for text contrast
                    brightness = (int(r) * 299 + int(g) * 587 + int(b) * 114) / 1000

        # Sort indices in descending order to avoid index shifting issues

        for idx in indices_to_delete:

    # --- Interaction Logic ---
    def _to_img_coords(self, cx, cy):

        # cx = (img_x * zoom) + offset  => img_x = (cx - offset) / zoom
        ix = int((self.canvas.canvasx(cx) - getattr(self, 'canvas_offset_x', 0)) / self.zoom_level)

    def _handle_point_click(self, event):

    # --- Area Logic (Brief) ---
    def _on_area_press(self, e):

    def _on_area_release(self, e):

        x1, y1 = self._to_img_coords(min(self.start_x, self.canvas.canvasx(e.x)), min(self.start_y, self.canvas.canvasy(e.y)))

        roi = self.blurred_cv_image[y1:y2, x1:x2]
        if roi.size == 0: return
        pixels = roi.reshape(-1, 3).astype(np.float32)
        _, _, centers = cv2.kmeans(pixels, k, None, (cv2.TERM_CRITERIA_EPS + cv2.TERM_CRITERIA_MAX_ITER, 10, 1.0), 10, cv2.KMEANS_RANDOM_CENTERS)
        
        new_pts = []
        for c in centers:
            dists = np.linalg.norm(pixels - c, axis=1)
            idx = np.argmin(dists)
            ry, rx = np.unravel_index(idx, (roi.shape[0], roi.shape[1]))
            new_pts.append({"x": int(rx+x1), "y": int(ry+y1), "radius": 7})
            
        fname = os.path.basename(self.image_paths[self.current_image_index])
        if fname not in self.image_points: self.image_points[fname] = []
        self.image_points[fname].extend(new_pts)
        self.redraw_canvas()
        self._update_point_list()

    def _perform_getcolors(self, x1, y1, x2, y2):
        # USE BLURRED IMAGE
        roi = self.blurred_cv_image[y1:y2, x1:x2]
        if roi.size == 0: return
        pil = Image.fromarray(cv2.cvtColor(roi, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB))
        cols = pil.getcolors(maxcolors=10000)
        if not cols: return
        
        seen = set()
        new_pts = []
        for r in range(roi.shape[0]):
            for c in range(roi.shape[1]):
                color = tuple(roi[r,c]) # BGR
                if color not in seen:
                    seen.add(color)
                    new_pts.append({"x": c+x1, "y": r+y1, "radius": 7})
        
        fname = os.path.basename(self.image_paths[self.current_image_index])
        if fname not in self.image_points: self.image_points[fname] = []
        self.image_points[fname].extend(new_pts)
        self.redraw_canvas()
        self._update_point_list()

    def next_image(self):
        if self.current_image_index < len(self.image_paths) - 1:
            self.current_image_index += 1
            self.load_image()
    
    def prev_image(self):
        if self.current_image_index > 0:
            self.current_image_index -= 1
            self.load_image()

    def clear_points(self):
        fname = os.path.basename(self.image_paths[self.current_image_index])
        self.image_points[fname] = []
        self.redraw_canvas()
        self._update_point_list()

    def save_and_close(self):
        try:
            for path in self.image_paths:
                fname = os.path.basename(path)
                pts = self.image_points.get(fname)
                if pts is not None:
                    self.project_manager.update_dataset_item_points(self.project_name, fname, pts)
            
            self.destroy()
            messagebox.showinfo("Saved", "Configuration saved.")
        except Exception as e: messagebox.showerror("Error", str(e))

# Roadmap: Persistent & Non-Destructive Blur

## Goal
Make the "Blur" setting in the Point Selector persistent across sessions and ensure it is applied during the actual color calibration pipeline. This allows users to smooth out noisy images (e.g., film grain, texture) to get cleaner color samples without permanently altering the source images.

## Core Concepts
1.  **Persistence:** The blur amount (kernel size) will be saved in the project configuration alongside the point coordinates for each image.
2.  **Non-Destructive:** The original images on disk remain untouched. The blur is applied dynamically in memory:
    *   **Visually:** In the GUI (Tkinter/Web) for user feedback.
    *   **Functionally:** In the backend pipeline when extracting color values from the defined coordinates.

## Phases

### Phase 1: Data Model & Persistence
- [x] Create Roadmap.
- [ ] **Schema Update:** Modify the project configuration schema (Pydantic models) to include `blur_kernel_size` (default: 0 or 1) for each dataset item configuration.
- [ ] **Backend (Project Manager):** Ensure the `ProjectManager` can read/write this new field.
- [ ] **Backend (API):** Update the Web API endpoints (`/save`) to accept and store the blur value.

### Phase 2: Pipeline Integration
- [ ] **Extraction Logic:** Locate the core logic that reads coordinates and samples colors (likely in `src/sample_manager` or `src/color_correction`).
- [ ] **Dynamic Blurring:** Inject a step to apply `cv2.GaussianBlur` to the image data *before* sampling the pixel colors, utilizing the stored `blur_kernel_size`.

### Phase 3: Tkinter GUI Integration
- [ ] **Load:** When loading an image, retrieve the saved `blur_kernel_size` and set the slider.
- [ ] **Save:** When clicking "Save & Close", write the current slider value to the config.

### Phase 4: Web GUI Integration
- [ ] **Load:** Update the frontend to initialize the Blur slider from the fetched project data.
- [ ] **Save:** Include the blur value in the payload sent to the save endpoint.

### Phase 5: Verification
- [ ] Verify that closing and reopening the app retains the blur setting.
- [ ] Verify that the generated color report reflects the smoothed colors, not the raw pixel noise.

        Initializes the ProjectManager.
        """
        self.managed_root = config.PROJECT_STORAGE_DIR
        self.managed_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        
        self.color_corrector = ColorCorrector()
        self.dataset_item_processor = DatasetItemProcessor()
        self.cache_dir = config.OUTPUT_DIR / "cache"
        self.cache_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.debug_mode = False
        self.db_manager = DatabaseManager()
        self._project_list_cache = None
        self._handle_data_migration() # Rename folders

    def _handle_data_migration(self):
        """Rename training_images directories and heal invalid absolute paths in DB and Config."""
        db = SessionLocal()
        try:
            projects = self.db_manager.list_projects(db)
            for project in projects:
                project_id = project.id
                project_path = self.managed_root / project_id
                
                # 1. Folder Migration
                old_dir = project_path / "training_images"
                new_dir = project_path / "calibration_images"
                if old_dir.exists() and not new_dir.exists():
                    logger.info(f"Migrating folder: {old_dir} -> {new_dir}")
                    try: old_dir.rename(new_dir)
                    except Exception as e: logger.error(f"Failed to rename folder {old_dir}: {e}")

                # 2. Asset Path Healing (Database Table)
                assets = self.db_manager.list_project_assets(db, project_id=project_id)
                for asset in assets:
                    if not asset.file_path: continue
                    
                    # Check if path is valid in current environment
                    resolved = resolve_platform_path(asset.file_path)
                    if os.path.exists(resolved):
                        # Path is accessible (either directly or via resolution). 
                        # Do NOT modify DB to avoid flip-flopping between Docker/Host paths.
                        continue

                    # If we reach here, the file is truly missing or unresolvable.
                    # Try to heal it by looking in expected managed location.
                    logger.warning(f"Asset path {asset.file_path} not found. Attempting to heal...")
                    
                    sub_dir = "assets"
                    if asset.category == "calibration_image": sub_dir = "calibration_images"
                    elif asset.category == "drawing_layer": sub_dir = "drawing_layers"
                    
                    potential_path = project_path / sub_dir / asset.filename
                    if potential_path.exists():
                        logger.info(f"Healing DB asset path for {asset.filename}: {potential_path}")
                        asset.file_path = str(potential_path)

                # 3. Recursive Config Healing (JSON)
                if project.config:
                    def heal_dict(d):
                        modified = False
                        if not isinstance(d, dict): return modified
                        
                        # Handle specific key rename first
                        if 'training_path' in d:
                            d['calibration_path'] = d.pop('training_path').replace('training_images', 'calibration_images')
                            modified = True

                        for k, v in d.items():
                            if isinstance(v, dict):
                                if heal_dict(v): modified = True
                            elif isinstance(v, str):
                                # Check if it looks like a path we need to heal
                                is_docker = v.startswith('/app/') or v.startswith('\\app\\')
                                looks_like_absolute = v.startswith('/') or (len(v) > 2 and v[1:3] == ':\\')
                                
                                if is_docker or looks_like_absolute or not Path(v).exists():
                                    # Try to extract filename robustly
                                    filename = get_portable_basename(v)
                                    sub_dir = "assets"
                                    if "drawing_layers" in v: sub_dir = "drawing_layers"
                                    elif "calibration_images" in v or "training_images" in v: sub_dir = "calibration_images"
                                    
                                    potential = project_path / sub_dir / filename
                                    if potential.exists():
                                        # Prefer relative paths in config for portability
                                        d[k] = f"{sub_dir}/{filename}"
                                        modified = True
                                    elif is_docker or looks_like_absolute:
                                        # Force relative for fallback
                                        d[k] = f"{sub_dir}/{filename}"
                                        modified = True
                        return modified

                    config_data = dict(project.config)
                    if heal_dict(config_data):
                        project.config = config_data
                        logger.info(f"Healed config JSON for project: {project.name}")

            db.commit()
        finally:
            db.close()

    def create_project(self, name: str) -> List[str]:
        """
        Scaffolds a new project in the database and managed storage.
        """
        messages = []
        db = SessionLocal()
        try:
            # 1. DB Check
            existing = self.db_manager.get_project(db, name=name)
            if existing:
                return [f"Error: Project '{name}' already exists."]

            # 2. Scaffolding
            # Construct default config
            global_cc_path = str(config.GLOBAL_COLOR_CHECKER_REFERENCE_PATH.resolve()).replace('\\', '/')
            global_aruco_path = str(config.GLOBAL_ARUCO_REFERENCE_PATH.resolve()).replace('\\', '/')

            default_config = {
                "calibration_path": "calibration_images",
                "object_reference_path": "assets/object_reference.png",
                "color_correction": {
                    "reference_color_checker_path": global_cc_path,
                    "project_specific_color_checker_path": "assets/project_color_checker.png"
                },
                "geometrical_alignment": {
                    "reference_path": global_aruco_path,
                    "marker_map": {},
                    "output_size": [1000, 1000]
                },
                "masking": {
                    "drawing_layers": {
                        "1": "drawing_layers/layer1.png",
                        "2": "drawing_layers/layer2.png",
                        "3": "drawing_layers/layer3.png"
                    }
                }
            }

            # 3. Create in DB
            project = self.db_manager.create_project(db, name=name, config=default_config)
            messages.append(f"Registered project '{name}' in database (ID: {project.id}).")

            # 4. Create Directories in Managed Storage
            project_path = self.managed_root / project.id
            (project_path / "calibration_images").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            (project_path / "drawing_layers").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            (project_path / "assets").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            
            messages.append(f"Created managed storage at {project_path}")
            
            # 5. Initialize Assets in DB
            # We add placeholders to DB so resolution works
            self.db_manager.add_project_asset(db, name, "ideal_checker", "global_reference", global_cc_path, project_id=project.id)
            self.db_manager.add_project_asset(db, name, "aruco_ref", "global_reference", global_aruco_path, project_id=project.id)

            db.commit()
            self._project_list_cache = None  # Invalidate cache
            messages.append(f"Project '{name}' initialized successfully.")
            return messages

        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Failed to create project: {e}")
            return [f"Error: {e}"]
        finally:
            db.close()

    def delete_project(self, project_name: str) -> List[str]:
        """
        Deletes a project completely from the database and managed storage.
        """
        messages = []
        db = SessionLocal()
        try:
            project = self.db_manager.get_project(db, name=project_name)
            if not project:
                return [f"Error: Project '{project_name}' not found."]

            project_id = project.id
            
            # 1. Delete Managed Storage
            project_storage = self.managed_root / project_id
            if project_storage.exists():
                import shutil
                try:
                    shutil.rmtree(project_storage)
                    messages.append(f"Deleted managed storage at {project_storage}")
                except Exception as e:
                    messages.append(f"Warning: Failed to delete some files in storage: {e}")

            # 2. Delete from DB (Assets and metrics are cascade deleted by SQLAlchemy)
            db.delete(project)
            db.commit()
            messages.append(f"Deleted project '{project_name}' from database.")
            
            # 3. Clear Cache
            self._project_list_cache = None # Invalidate list cache
            self.clear_cache_for_project(project_name)
            
            return messages
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Failed to delete project: {e}")
            return [f"Error: {e}"]
        finally:
            db.close()

    def _get_cache_file_path(self, project_name: str) -> Path:
        """
        Constructs the file path for the cache file associated with a given project.
        """
        return self.cache_dir / f"{project_name}_cache.json"

    def clear_cache_for_project(self, project_name: str):
        """
        Deletes the cache file and associated cached images for a specific project.
        """
        cache_file_path = self._get_cache_file_path(project_name)
        if cache_file_path.exists():
            try:
                os.remove(cache_file_path)
                if self.debug_mode:
                    print(f"[DEBUG] Deleted cache file: {cache_file_path}")
            except OSError as e:
                print(f"[ERROR] Could not delete cache file {cache_file_path}: {e}")

        # Also remove any cached corrected calibration images for that project
        try:
            for f in self.cache_dir.glob(f"{project_name}_corrected_calibration_*.png"):
                os.remove(f)
                if self.debug_mode:
                    print(f"[DEBUG] Deleted cached image: {f}")
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"[ERROR] Error deleting cached images for project {project_name}: {e}")
